command cards.name: Light Airdrop
command cards.text: Starting on round two, you can play this card any time during the activation of one of your Gravedigger models/units. When you play this card, choose one of the activating models and whether to drop an Ammo Crate, Fuel Canister, Mantlet, or a Medical Crate. Add the selected defense or model to your army. Place the airdropped model within 1" away from the chosen activating model.

command cards.name: Heavy Airdrop
command cards.text: Starting on round two, you can play this card any time during the activation of one of your Gravedigger models/units. When you play this card, choose whether to airdrop either a Heavy Weapon Crate or a Squad Class light warjack (Blocker, Raider, or Skirmisher). Add the selected model to your army. Place the airdropped model 1" away from the model/unit this card was played on. You can only choose to airdrop a Squad Class light warjack if you played this card on a Gravedigger model/unit with 'Jack Marshal that is not already controlling warjack. The warjack is considered to be controlled by the model/unit this card was played on. An airdropped warjack must forfeit its Normal Movement or Combat Action the turn it enters play.

feat.Technological Superiority: Warjacks in Syntherion's battlegroup beginning their activations in his control range can charge without spending focus and gain an additional die on their attack rolls. Technological Superiority lasts for one turn.

feat.Mathematical Perfection: The base MAT and RAT of friendly Faction models in Directrix's control range are each equal to her current ARC stat for one turn.

rules.Companion [Iron Mother Directrix]: Two of these models are included in any army that includes Iron Mother Directrix. If Directrix is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Directrix's battlegroup.

rules.Attached: Before the start of the game, attach this model to a friendly Faction Leader for the rest of the game. Each Leader can have only one model/unit attached to it. The attached model is part of its Leader's battlegroup.

rules.Orbit: This model does not begin the game in play and does not activate. This model cannot be targeted or hit by attacks made by the model that put it into play. If the model that put it into play is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play.

rules.Created: This model does not begin the game in play.
rules.Explosive Decomposition: This model explodes if it contacts an enemy model while advancing or if it becomes knocked down. When this model explodes, models within 2" of it suffer an unboostable POW 12 corrosion damage roll and the Corrosion continuous effect, then this model is removed from play.
rules.Inconsequential: This model can not score or contest Objectives, Scenario terrain, or Caches.
rules.Self-Propelled: This model cannot forfeit its Normal Movement. When this model makes its Normal Movement, instead of moving it normally you must choose the direction it is moving. It then advances its SPD +d6 in a straight line. On a roll of 6, instead of moving this model explodes with the same effect as Explosive Decomposition and is removed from play.

rules.Battle Plan: This model can use one of the following plans at any time during its activation.
rules.Desperate Pace [Small-Based Liegemen]: RNG 5. Target friendly small-based Liegemen trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.
rules.Precision Strike: While within 10" of this model, friendly models ignore other friendly models when determining LOS. Friendly models can advance through other friendly models within 10" of this model if they have enough movement to move completely past them. Precision Strike lasts for one turn.

Stir the Blood.text: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, each affected model gains +2 to its next melee attack damage roll this turn.

Reposition [2\"].text: At the end of this model/unit's activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, this model can advance up to 2", then its activation ends.

rules.Veteran Leader [Liegemen]: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Liegemen models gain +1 to attack rolls.

rules.Alchemical Mask: This model does not suffer gas effects. When determining LOS or resolving attacks, this model ignores cloud effects and concealment granted from cloud effects.
rules.Journeyman Warcaster: This model is not a warcaster or Leader, but has the following warcaster special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Focus Manipulation, Power Field, and Spellcaster. This model must have at least one cohort in its battlegroup at the start of the game.
rules.Limited Battlegroup [Razor]: The only warjack that can be in this model's battlegroup is Razor.
rules.Prowl: While this model has concealment, it gains Stealth.

rules.Companion [Kapitan Zahara Vilkul]: This model is included in any army that includes Kapitan Zahara Vilkul. If Vilkul is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Vilkul's battlegroup.
rules.Anchor: Friendly warrior models cannot be knocked down while B2B with this model.
rules.Reposition [3\"]: At the end of this model/unit's activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, this model can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.
rules.Swift Hunter: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".
rules.Prowl: While this model has concealment, it gains Stealth.

rules.Close Control: While a cohort model in this model's battlegroup is in play, this model cannot go into the tunnels.
rules.Journeyman Warcaster: This model is not a warcaster or Leader, but has the following warcaster special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Focus Manipulation, Power Field, and Spellcaster. This model must have at least one cohort in its battlegroup at the start of the game.
rules.Unyielding: This model gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.

rules.Distant Deployment [12\"]: This model can be placed at the same time as your models with Advance Deployment, up to 12" beyond your deployment zone.
rules.Secured Perimeter [6\"]: Friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF while within 6" of this model.
rules.Spyglass (★ Action): Target an enemy model in this model's LOS. That model loses Stealth for one round.

rules.Cleave: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can make one additional melee attack. This model can gain only one additional attack from Cleave each activation.
rules.Sneak Attack: The turn this model ambushes, it gains +2 to attack and damage rolls against models within 5".
rules.Tunnel Ambush: When a model/unit with Tunnel Ambush ambushes, instead of being deployed to a table edge, one model can be placed in base contact with a friendly Trapdoor marker. The marker is then removed from the table and the other models in the unit are placed in base contact with the first model.

rules.Carapace: This model gains +4 ARM against ranged attack damage rolls.
This model gains +4 ARM against ranged attack damage rolls.
rules.Veteran Leader [Steelback]: While within 10" of this model, Steelback models gain +1 to attack rolls.

rules.Companion [Kithguard Journeyman]: This model is included in any army that includes the Kithguard Journeyman. If the Kithguard Journeyman is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of the Kithguard Journeyman's battlegroup.
rules.Bulldoze: When this model is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when this model makes a trample power attack.

Admonition.text: When an enemy model advances and ends its movement or is placed within 6" of target model in the spellcaster's battlegroup, the affected model can immediately advance up to 3", then Admonition expires.

Ignite.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to melee attack damage rolls. Affected models gain Critical Fire on their melee attacks.

Purification.text: Continuous effects, animi, and upkeep spells in the spellcaster's control range immediately expire.

Revive.text: Target one friendly trooper model. Return one destroyed Grunt model to the target model's unit. The Grunt is returned with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunt within 2" of the target model. The Grunt model must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is returned to play.

Stygian Abyss.text: On a critical hit, the model hit suffers Blind for one round. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or arcane attacks, suffers -4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)

Guided Fire.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, models in its battlegroup gain boosted ranged attack rolls for one turn.

Instability Equation.text: Target friendly warjack stands up and is no longer stationary. If the warjack was suffering Disruption, it is no longer disrupted. The warjack gains up to 3 focus points and gains Unstable for one turn. (At the end of an activation in which a model with Unstable spent more than 1 focus point, roll a d6. If the roll is equal to or less than the number of focus points spent, the model with Unstable explodes and other models within 3" of it suffer an unboostable POW 14 blast damage roll. Remove the model with Unstable from play.)

Burning Ash.text: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster's control range. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. While in the template, living enemy models without Resistance: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls.

Disintegration.text: The model hit suffers –2 ARM for one round. A model boxed by Disintegration is removed from play.

Force Hammer.text: Instead of suffering a normal damage roll, a non-incorporeal model Force Hammer hits is slammed d6" directly away from the spell's point of origin and suffers a POW 12 damage roll. Collateral damage from this slam is POW 12.

Iron Flesh.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM and Resistance: Blast.

Telekinesis.text: Place target friendly model completely within 2" of its current location. A model can be placed by Telekinesis only once per turn.

Bombshell.text: On a critical hit, models hit are thrown d6" directly away from the attacker. Roll distance once for all models affected. Move models farthest from the attacker first. Instead of suffering blast damage, models hit but not directly hit suffer a POW 10 damage roll. The POW of collateral damage is 10.

Engine of Destruction.text: The spellcaster gains +2 SPD and +4 MAT and +4 to its melee damage rolls for one turn.

Jackhammer.text: Target model in the spellcaster's battlegroup currently in its control range immediately makes one basic melee attack.

Redline.text: Target warjack in the spellcaster's battlegroup gains +2 SPD and can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without spending focus. Additionally, the affected model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and collateral damage rolls. At the end of each of its activations, the affected warjack suffers d3 damage points.

Road to War.text: When a friendly Faction model in the spellcaster's control range destroys one or more enemy models with a melee or ranged attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved one Cohort model in the spellcaster's battlegroup that is in its control range can advance up to 3". A model can advance as a result of Road to War only once per turn.

Sentry.text: Target friendly Faction model gains Rapid Fire. (A model with Rapid Fire can make one basic ranged attack during your Maintenance Phase.)

Fail-Safe.text: Target friendly Faction warjack gains +2 ARM and does not suffer the effects of crippled systems.

Jumpstart.text: Shakeable effects on models in the spellcaster's battlegroup that are currently in its control range expire. Models that suffered shakeable effects this turn are not affected by Jumpstart.

Mobility.text: Models in the spellcaster's battlegroup currently in its control range gain +2 SPD and Pathfinder for one turn.

Return Fire.text: When target friendly Faction model is targeted by an enemy ranged attack, after the attack is resolved the affected model can make one basic melee or ranged attack, then Return Fire expires. Return Fire lasts for one round.

Arcane Propulsion.text: Target cohort model in the spellcaster's battlegroup gains +2 SPD, +2 DEF, and Flight.

Firepower.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to its ranged attack damage rolls.

Occultation.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Stealth.

Tides of War.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, models in its battlegroup gain Reposition [3"]. Tides of War lasts for one turn.

Windstorm.text: The spellcaster gains Warping Winds. Windstorm lasts for one round. (When a friendly Faction model is targeted by a ranged attack while within 3" of this model, the attack suffers -3 RNG. Additionally, while within 3" of this model, friendly Faction models gain Resistance: Blast.)

Boundless Charge.text: During its activation, target friendly Faction model can charge without spending focus or being forced and gains +2 SPD and Pathfinder when it charges. Boundless Charge lasts for one turn.

Deceleration.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 ARM against ranged and arcane attack damage rolls. Deceleration lasts for one round.

Hot-Shot.text: Target model in the spellcaster's battlegroup gains boosted ranged attack damage rolls.

Snipe.text: Target friendly Faction model's/unit's ranged weapons gain +3 RNG.

Abattoir.text: Models in the spellcaster's battlegroup currently in its control range can immediately make one basic melee attack. Abattoir can be cast only once per turn.

Castigate.text: Enemy models cannot be used to channel spells or be forced to cast an animus while in the spellcaster's control range. Castigate lasts for one round.

Onslaught.text: The spellcaster and friendly Faction models beginning their activations in its control range gain Relentless Charge for one turn. (While advancing as part of a charge, a model with Relentless Charge gains Pathfinder.)

Psycho Surgery.text: Each model in the spellcaster's battlegroup currently in its control range can immediately remove d3 + 1 damage points. This spell can be cast only once per activation.

Deadweight.text: When Deadweight destroys an enemy living or undead model, choose an enemy model within 2" of it. The chosen model must forfeit either its Normal Movement or its Combat Action during its next activation, as its controller chooses.

Occult Whispers.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on their Arcane Attack rolls. Occult Whispers lasts for one turn.

Scything Touch.text: Target friendly Faction model gains Dark Shroud. (While within 2" of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer – 2 ARM.)

Crippling Grasp.text: Target model/unit suffers –2 SPD, DEF, and ARM. Additionally, an affected model suffers –2 to its melee attack damage rolls.

Dash.text: The spellcaster and friendly Faction warrior models activating in its control range gain +1 SPD. Dash lasts for one turn.

Hex Blast.text: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on the model/unit directly hit by Hex Blast immediately expire.

Influence.text: Take control of target enemy non-Leader warrior model. The model immediately makes one basic attack, then Influence expires. A model can be affected by Influence only once per turn.

Dark Seduction.text: Take control of target enemy non-Leader warrior model. You can immediately make a full advance with that enemy model followed by a basic attack, then Dark Seduction expires. Dark Seduction can be cast only once per activation. A model can be affected by Dark Seduction only once per turn.

Vision.text: When target friendly Faction model is directly hit by an attack, you can choose to have it suffer no damage roll from the attack, then Vision expires.

Bladed Gale.text: Models hit lose Flight for one round.

Hand of Destruction.text: Friendly models in this model's battlegroup gain an additional die on attack and damage rolls against target model/unit. Discard the lowest die in each roll.

Spirit Door.text: Choose a model in the spellcaster's battlegroup that is in its control range. Immediately place that model completely within 2" of the spellcaster. If the chosen model is the spellcaster, immediately place it completely within 2" of another model in its battlegroup that was in its control range at the time the spell was cast. A model cannot advance or attack after being placed by Spirit Door this turn.

Battering Ram.text: An enemy model hit by Battering Ram can be pushed 3" directly away from the spell's point of origin.

Iron Aggression.text: Target friendly Faction warjack can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without spending focus and gains boosted melee attack rolls.

Razor Wall.text: Place a wall template anywhere completely within the spellcaster's control range where it does not touch a model's base, an obstruction, or an obstacle. When a model enters or ends its activation in the wall template, it suffers 1 damage point.

Unstoppable Force.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, models in its battlegroup gain Bulldoze. Unstoppable Force lasts for one turn.

Avenging Force.text: If one or more friendly Faction warrior models were damaged by enemy attacks while in the spellcaster's control range during your opponent's last turn, during your Maintenance Phase one model in the spellcaster's battlegroup in its control range can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.

Forced Induction.text: On a direct hit, target enemy Cohort gains 1 focus, fury or essence point. Then the target Cohort model and each enemy model within 1" for each focus, fury or essence point on it suffer an unboostable POW 10 electrical damage roll.

Magic Bullet.text: If target friendly Faction model's next basic ranged attack directly hits, after resolving the attack choose another model within 4" of the model hit. The chosen model suffers an unboostable POW 12 magical damage roll. The point of origin for this damage is the model hit. This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack. After resolving this damage roll, Magic Bullet expires. Magic Bullet lasts for one turn.

Second Sight.text: Target friendly model gains Eyeless Sight.

Spellpiercer.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, the weapons of friendly Faction models gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical. Spellpiercer lasts for one turn.

Discontinuity.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, the melee weapons of models in its battlegroup gain Dispel. (When a weapon with Dispel hits a model/unit, upkeep spells and animi on that model/unit immediately expire.) Discontinuity lasts for one round.

Dissolution Bolt.text: A model hit by Dissolution Bolt cannot channel spells for one round.

Positive Charge.text: Target friendly Faction Cohort model gains +2 to melee attack and melee damage rolls. While within 3" of the affected Cohort model, other friendly Faction models gain +2 on melee attack and melee damage rolls. Positive Charge lasts for one turn.

Watcher.text: Once per turn when an enemy model advances and ends its movement within 6" of the spellcaster, you can choose a Cohort model in the spellcaster's battlegroup that is in its control range. That Cohort model can immediately make a full advance toward the enemy model and then can make one basic attack targeting the enemy model.

Convection.text: When Convection destroys a living enemy model, you can give 1 focus point to a warjack in the spellcaster's battlegroup that is in its control range.

Energizer.text: Each model in the spellcaster's battlegroup that is currently in its control range can immediately advance up to 2". Energizer can be cast only once per activation.

Magnetic Hold (spell).text: Target enemy model/unit suffers –2 SPD and DEF and cannot charge or make slam or trample power attacks. Friendly Faction construct models charging an affected model gain +2 SPD.

Synergy.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, models in this model's battlegroup gain a +1 cumulative bonus on melee attack and melee damage rolls for each other model in the battlegroup that hit an enemy model with a melee attack this turn while in the spellcaster's control range. This cumulative bonus cannot exceed +3.

Arcantrik Bolt.text: A warjack damaged by this attack becomes stationary for one round.

Feedback Loop.text: When target enemy Cohort model that is part of a battlegroup is damaged, its controller suffers 1 damage point.

Fire Group.text: While models in the spellcaster's battlegroup are in its control range, their ranged weapons gain +2 RNG. Fire Group lasts for one turn.

Shrapnel Swarm.text: On a direct hit, after resolving the damage roll, the model hit and models within 1" suffer 1 damage point.

Tactical Supremacy.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Reposition [3"]. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]'s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

Censure.text: Enemy upkeep spells in the spellcaster's control range immediately expire. A model can keep any of its upkeep spells in play by suffering d3 damage points per spell. Roll a separate d3 for each spell. This damage cannot be transferred or reduced by spending focus points. Remove one damage point from the spellcaster for each damage point caused by Censure. Censure can be cast only one per activation.

Curse of Shadows.text: Target model/unit suffers -2 ARM. A model can advance through an affected model if it has enough movement to move completely past its base.

Hellfire.text: Models disabled by Hellfire cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by Hellfire are removed from play.

Hellmouth.text: On a direct hit, before making the damage roll, push models within 2" of the model directly hit 2" directly toward it in the order you choose. Models boxed by Hellmouth are removed from play.

Teleport.text: Place the spellcaster anywhere completely within 6" of its current location, then its activation ends.

Tether.text: Immediately after the spellcaster ends its Normal Movement, target cohort in its battlegroup can advance up to 3" directly toward it.

Breath of Corruption.text: This attack causes corrosion damage. On a hit, center a cloud effect on the model targeted. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. A model without Resistance: Corrosion entering or ending its activation in the AOE suffers 1 point of corrosion damage.

Flashing Blade.text: The spellcaster immediately makes one basic attack with one of its melee weapons against each enemy model in its LOS that is in the weapon's melee range. These attacks are simultaneous.

Locked Horns.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, friendly Faction models gain Unyielding. Locked Horns lasts for one round. (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

Soulfire.text: When a living, non-soulless enemy model is boxed by Soulfire, the spellcaster gains 1 focus, fury, or essence point and the boxed model is removed from play. If the spellcaster does not have a special rule that allows it to gain focus, fury, or essence points, it cannot gain a focus, fury, or essence point as a result of Soulfire.

Expendable Creation.text: Target non-huge based horror in the spellcaster's battlegroup gains +2 SPD and can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without spending essence. Additionally, the affected model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and collateral damage rolls. At the end of each of its activations, the affected horror suffers D3 damage points.

Black Spot.text: Target enemy warrior model/unit suffers -2 DEF. When a friendly Faction model destroys one or more affected models with a basic melee or ranged attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it can make one additional melee or ranged attack. Attacks gained from Black Spot cannot generate additional attacks from Black Spot.

Carnivore.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to melee attack rolls. When an affected model destroys a living or undead model with a melee attack, the destroyed model is removed from play and the spellcaster can remove d3 damage points.

Ghost Walk.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Ghostly for one turn. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

Rites of Torment.text: When a friendly Faction model in the spellcaster's control range destroys one or more enemy models with a melee or ranged attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved one horror in the spellcaster's battlegroup in its control range can advance up to 3". A horror can advance once per turn as a result of Rites of Torment.

Abuse.text: Target friendly Faction warbeast gains +2 SPD and +2 to its melee attack damage rolls for one turn but suffers d3 damage points.

Awakened Spirit.text: Target warbeast in the spellcaster's battlegroup can cast its animus once during its activation without being forced. A warbeast that casts its animus as a result of Awakened Spirit cannot also be forced to cast its animus that activation.

Discordance.text: Models in this model's battlegroup gain Wailing. (While within 5" of a model with Wailing, enemy models cannot cast or channel spells.)

Tantrum.text: If one or more models in the spellcaster's battlegroup were damaged by enemy attacks while within 5" of the spellcaster during your opponent's last turn, during your Maintenance Phase one model in the spellcaster's battlegroup in its control range can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.

Abyssal Gate.text: When Abyssal Gate damages a non-Leader enemy model, after the attack is resolved you can place the enemy model anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. A model can be placed by Abyssal Gate only once per turn.

Artifice of Deviation.text: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster's control range. While in the template, friendly Faction models gain cover. Enemy models treat the template as rough terrain.

Enfeeble.text: Target model/unit suffers -2 to attack and damage rolls.

Manifest Destiny.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, models in its battlegroup gain an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls. Discard the lowest die of each roll. Manifest Destiny lasts for one turn.

Mirage.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Apparition. (During your Control Phase, place models with Apparition anywhere completely within 2" of their current locations.)

Gallows.text: When an enemy model is hit by this attack, it can be pushed d6" directly toward Gallows' point of origin.

Wall of Fire.text: Place the wall template anywhere completely within the spellcaster's control range where it does not touch a model's base, an obstruction, or an obstacle. When a model enters or ends its activation in the wall template, it suffers an unboostable POW 12 fire damage roll and the Fire continuous effect. Models within the wall template gain concealment.

Ashes to Ashes.text: If target model is directly hit, the d3 nearest enemy models within 4" of it suffer a POW 10 fire damage roll. These additional damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Resolve damage resulting from Ashes to Ashes simultaneously with the damage resulting from the attack that directly hit.

Breath Stealer.text: Target model/unit suffers -2 SPD and DEF for one round.

Death to Dust.text: A model boxed by this attack is removed from play.

Sands of Fate.text: Remove a friendly living Faction trooper model in the spellcaster's control range from play and replace it with the spellcaster. The spellcaster cannot advance this activation after being placed by Sands of Fate.

Fog of War.text: Models gain concealment while in the spellcaster's control range.

Repudiate.text: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on the model/unit directly hit by Repudiate immediately expire. When an upkeep spell expires as a result of Repudiate, the model maintaining the spell suffers d3 damage points.

Star-Crossed.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, enemy models gain an additional die on attack rolls. Discard the highest die of each roll. Star-Crossed lasts for one round.

Veil of Mists.text: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster's control range. The template does not block friendly Faction models' LOS. While in the template, friendly Faction models gain Pathfinder and can move through obstructions and other models if they have enough movement to move completely past them.

Reconstruct.text: When target large-based or smaller Cohort model in the spellcaster's battlegroup is disabled by an enemy attack place it anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Remove 1 damage point from each system or aspect, then Reconstruct expires.

Scourge.text: On a direct hit, models hit by this attack become knocked down.

Carrion Feast.text: Center a cloud effect template on the model directly hit. The template is a hazard and remains in play as long as upkeep is paid. While in the template, enemy models suffer -2 ARM.

Annihilation.text: Models destroyed by Annihilation are removed from play and do not generate corpse tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed by Annihilation, the spellcaster gains the destroyed model's soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

Death Ward.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM. If an affected warjack is damaged, choose which column suffers the damage.

Impending Doom.text: Enemy models within 5" of the spellcaster are pushed 5" directly toward it in the order you choose.

Shadowmancer.text: While in spellcaster's control range, models in its battlegroup gain Stealth and Dark Shroud. Shadowmancer lasts for one round. (While within 2" of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer -2 ARM.)

Death's Dominion.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, friendly Undead models gain Resistance: Blast and Rise. (If a model with Rise is knocked down at the beginning of your Maintenance Phase, it stands up.)

Excarnate.text: When a living enemy warrior model is boxed by Excarnate, remove it from play. You can then add one Grunt to a friendly Faction small-based undead unit in the spellcaster's control range. Place the Grunt within 1" of another model in the unit. The Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is put into play.

Gravetouched.text: While within 2" of target friendly Faction model, enemy models suffer -2 DEF.

Hellwrought.text: Target Cohort model in the spellcaster's battlegroup gains +2 ARM and Retaliation. (If a model with Retaliation was damaged by an enemy attack during the last round, during your Maintenance Phase it can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.)

Banishing Ward.text: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on target friendly model/unit expire. Affected models cannot be targeted by enemy spells or animi.

Crimson Veil.text: Target friendly Faction model's melee weapons gain Blood Shadow. (If an attack with a weapon with Blood Shadow boxes a living or undead model, this model can gain Incorporeal for one round.)

Venom.text: Venom causes corrosion damage. Models hit suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.

Soul Shift.text: Remove a friendly Faction warrior model within 4" of the spellcaster from play and replace it with a friendly Faction cohort model within 4" of the spellcaster. The cohort model must forfeit its Normal Movement and cannot attack after being placed by Soul Shift this turn. Soul Shift can only be cast once per turn.

Carnage.text: Friendly Faction models gain +2 to melee attack rolls against enemy models in the spellcaster's control range. Carnage lasts for one turn.

Earth's Sanctuary.text: Target friendly Faction model becomes dug in. (While dug in, a model gains cover, gains Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged.)

Escort.text: Cohort models in the spellcaster's battlegroup beginning their activations in the spellcaster's control range gain +2 SPD when advancing as part of their Normal Movement. The spellcaster gains +2 ARM while one or more cohort models in its battlegroup are within 3" of it.

Silence of Death.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and Take Down. Models disabled by a melee attack made by a model with Take Down cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by a melee attack made by a model with Take Down are removed from play.)

Fire For Effect.text: Boost the attack and damage rolls of target friendly Faction model's first ranged attack each activation.

Fury's Strength.text: Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls for one turn.

Inhospitable Ground.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, enemy models treat open terrain as rough terrain. Inhospitable Ground lasts for one round.

Arcane Charge.text: On a direct hit, models hit suffer −2 ARM for one turn.

Shadow Step.text: Enemy models currently within 2" of the spellcaster suffer Shadow Bind for one round. Additionally, you can place the spellcaster anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Shadow Step can be cast only once per activation. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers −3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)

Chasten.text: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on target model/unit damaged by this attack expire.

Eliminator.text: Immediately after this attack is resolved, the spellcaster can advance up to 2" for each enemy model destroyed by the attack.

Blur.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +3 DEF against ranged and arcane attacks.

Calamity.text: Target enemy model/unit suffers −2 DEF and ARM.

Heightened Reflexes.text: Target friendly model can not be knocked down or made stationary for one round.

Mage Sight.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, models in its battlegroup gain Eyeless Sight.

Rhythm of War.text: Warjacks in this model's battlegroup that are in its control range can advance up to 3" after all friendly models have ended their activations on your turn.

Rift.text: Center a 3" template on the model directly hit. The template is rough terrain and remains in play for one round.

Rock Wall.text: Place a wall template anywhere completely within the spellcaster's control range where it does not touch a model's base, an obstruction, or an obstacle. The wall is an obstacle that provides cover. The wall is removed from the table if it is contacted by a model with an extra-large or huge base.

Electrify.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls, Resistance: Electricity, and Repulsor Field. (When a model with Repulsor Field is hit with a melee attack, after the attack is resolved the attacking model is pushed 1" directly away from that model.)

Lightning Pulse.text: A model hit by Lightning Pulse suffers a POW 10 electrical damage roll, and lightning arcs to the nearest model within 3" of the model hit, ignoring the attacking model. The model the lightning arcs to suffers an unboostable POW 10 electrical damage roll. Lightning arc damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Lightning Pulse damage rolls are simultaneous with the damage from the attack that caused the leap.

Arcane Shield.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +3 ARM.

Snipe (spell).text: Target friendly Faction model's/unit's ranged weapons gain +3 RNG.

Blinding Light.text: A model/unit hit by this spell cannot make ranged or arcane attacks and suffers −2 DEF for one round.

Hand of Morrow.text: Target friendly Faction model's/unit's weapons gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical.

Countermeasure.text: While within 5" of target friendly Faction model/unit, enemy models cannot make ranged attacks.

Crusader's Call.text: Friendly Faction models beginning a charge in the spellcaster's control range gain +2 SPD. Crusader's Call lasts for one turn.

Lock the Target.text: A model damaged by Lock the Target cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks for one round.

Full Throttle.text: Warjacks in the spellcaster's battlegroup beginning their activations in its control range can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without spending focus that activation. While in the spellcaster's control range, models in its battlegroup gain boosted melee attack rolls. Full Throttle lasts for one turn.

Ground Zero.text: Other models within 3" of the spellcaster suffer a POW 13 blast damage roll. Immediately after this damage is resolved each enemy model damaged by Ground Zero is pushed d6" directly away from the spellcaster in the order you choose.

Storm Rager.text: Target friendly Faction warrior model gains +2 MAT and ARM and +2 on melee attack damage rolls and cannot be targeted by combined ranged attacks or combined melee attacks.

Open Fire.text: Target Cohort model in this model's battlegroup that is in its control range can immediately make one basic ranged attack. A model can be targeted by Open Fire only once per turn.

Call of the Grave.text: Models damaged by Call of the Grave suffer Shadow Bind for one round. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers −3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)

Veil of Darkness.text: When target friendly Faction model/unit is targeted by a ranged attack, the attack suffers −5 RNG.

Mortality.text: Target model/unit suffers −2 DEF and ARM, loses Tough, and cannot have damage removed from it. Mortality lasts for one round.

Pursuit.text: If target enemy model/unit advances during its activation, one model in the spellcaster's battlegroup that is in its control range can immediately make a full advance.

Heart of Ice.text: Target friendly Faction non-construct model/unit gains +2 ARM and Resistance: Cold. When an affected model is destroyed or removed from play by a melee attack made by an enemy warrior model, at the end of its activation the attacking model becomes stationary for one round unless it has Resistance: Cold.

Snowsquall.text: Enemy models activating in this model's control range lose Eyeless Sight, Flight, and Pathfinder for one turn.

Winter's Wrath.text: Winter's Wrath causes cold damage. On a critical hit, models hit become stationary for one round unless they have Resistance: Cold.

Winter Coat.text: The spellcaster gains Resistance: Cold and Freezer. Winter Coat lasts for one round. (When an enemy model without Resistance: Cold ends its activation within 2" of a model with Freezer, the enemy model becomes stationary for one round.)

Snow-Wreathed.text: The spellcaster has concealment. Snow-Wreathed lasts for one round.

Inviolable Resolve.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM and cannot be knocked down or moved by a push or a slam.

Kiss of Lyliss.text: When a friendly Faction model makes a damage roll against a model/unit hit by Kiss of Lyliss, add +2 to the roll.

Stranglehold.text: A model damaged by Stranglehold forfeits either its Normal Movement or its Combat Action during its next activation, as its controller chooses.

Force Blast.text: Target a model in the spellcaster's battlegroup that is in its control range. Enemy models currently within 2" of the target model are pushed 2" directly away from it in the order you choose.

Grave Wind.text: Target friendly Faction model gains +2 DEF and Poltergeist. (When an enemy model misses a model with Poltergeist with an attack, immediately after the attack is resolved you can choose to push the enemy model d3" directly away from the model with Poltergeist.)

Polarity Shield.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Polarity Field. (A model with Polarity Field cannot be targeted by a charge or slam power attack made by a construct model.)

Hunter's Mark.text: Friendly models can charge or make a slam power attack against target enemy model hit by Hunter's Mark without being forced or spending focus. A friendly model charging or power attack slamming an enemy model hit by Hunter's Mark gains +2 SPD while resolving the charge or slam. Hunter's Mark lasts for one turn.

Wind Rush.text: The spellcaster can immediately make a full advance and gains +2 DEF for one round. Wind Rush can be cast only once per activation.

Pin Cushion.text: Friendly Faction models gain an additional die on ranged attack and ranged damage rolls against target model/unit. Discard the lowest die in each roll.

Refuge.text: At the end of an activation in which target friendly Faction model hit an enemy model with an attack, the affected model can make a full advance.

Shadow Pack.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, models in its battlegroup gain Stealth. Shadow Pack lasts for one round.

Wild Aggression.text: Target friendly living warbeast in the spellcaster's battlegroup can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without being forced and gains boosted melee attack rolls.

Forced Evolution.text: Target friendly living Faction warbeast gains +2 DEF and +2 to its melee attack damage rolls

Muzzle.text: An enemy warbeast damaged by Muzzle cannot advance toward the spellcaster for one round.

Arcane Might.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, friendly Faction non-Leader warrior models can spend 1 focus or fury point on the spellcaster to boost a melee attack or melee damage roll during their activations.

Spirit Fang.text: A model damaged by this attack suffers −2 SPD and DEF for one round.

Deathbringers.text: While within the spellcaster's control range, the melee weapons of models in its battlegroup gain Grievous Wounds. Deathbringers lasts for one turn. (A model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)

Wind Wall.text: The spellcaster cannot make ranged attacks after casting this spell, and non-magical ranged attacks targeting it automatically miss. While within 3" of the spellcaster, models cannot make ranged attacks and non-magical ranged attacks targeting them automatically miss. Wind Wall lasts for one round.

Harvest.text: When a living or undead enemy model is destroyed in the spellcaster's control range, the spellcaster can gain 1 fury point. The spellcaster's fury point total cannot exceed its ARC as a result of Harvest.

Lashing Tendrils.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit's melee weapons become RNG 2 and gain Chain Weapon.

Rapid Growth.text: Place a 3" diameter template anywhere completely within the spellcaster's control range. The template is forest terrain that remains in play as long as its upkeep is paid.

Thistle.text: If the target model is within 2" of forest terrain, attack and damage rolls are boosted when resolving this spell.

Befuddle.text: On a hit, you can immediately take control and advance target enemy non-Leader model up to 3" then Befuddle expires. A model can move only once per turn as a result of Befuddle.

Earth Spikes.text: When making this attack, ignore cover and concealment. On a critical hit, models hit become knocked down.

Incite.text: Friendly Faction models gain +2 to attack and damage rolls against enemy models while the enemy models are within 10" of the spellcaster. Incite lasts for one turn.

Murder of Crows.text: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster's control range. An enemy model that enters or ends its activation in the AOE suffers an unboostable POW 8 damage roll.

Primal.text: Target friendly living Faction warbeast gains +2 MAT and +2 to its melee attack damage rolls for one round and automatically frenzies during your next Control Phase. The target warbeast frenzies even if Primal was removed by a spell, special rule, or casting of a new animus on it prior to your next Control Phase.

Massacre.text: The spellcaster gains Overtake. Massacre lasts for one turn. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

Rush.text: Target friendly Faction warbeast gains +2 SPD and gains Pathfinder. Rush lasts for one turn.

Lightning Strike.text: The spellcaster gains Sprint. Lightning Strike lasts for one turn. (At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, a model with Sprint can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.)

Rage Fuel.text: The spellcaster gains Primal Rage. Rage Fuel lasts for one round. (Once per turn, when a model with Primal Rage suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance toward the attacking model and can make one basic melee attack.)

Earth's Blessing.text: The spellcaster cannot be pushed, knocked down, made stationary, or moved by a slam. Earth's Blessing lasts for one round.

Rage.text: Target friendly Faction warbeast gains +2 to its melee damage rolls. Rage lasts for one turn.

Spirit Blade.text: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on target friendly Faction model/unit expire.

Wrathbane.text: Target friendly Faction model's weapons gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical. Wrathbane lasts for one turn.

Indomitable.text: The spellcaster gains Unyielding. Indomitable lasts for one round. (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

Undergrowth.text: While within 5" of the spellcaster, enemy models treat open terrain as rough terrain and suffer −2 DEF. Undergrowth lasts for one round.

Invocations of Wrath.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on attack rolls. Discard the lowest die in each roll. Invocations of Wrath lasts for one turn.

Tempest.text: On a direct hit, models hit become knocked down.

Dark Unraveling.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, the weapons of models in its battlegroup gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical. Dark Unraveling lasts for one turn.

Weald Secrets.text: Target model/unit gains Pathfinder and Prowl. (While a model with Prowl has concealment, it gains Stealth.)

Cold Front.text: The spellcaster gains Chiller for one turn. (While within 2" of a model with Chiller, enemy models without Resistance: Cold suffer −2 DEF.)

Cyclone.text: The spellcaster immediately makes a full advance. At the end of this movement, the spellcaster can make one basic melee attack against each model in its LOS that is in its melee range. Cyclone can be cast only once per activation.

Superiority.text: Target friendly Faction warjack gains +2 SPD, MAT, and DEF and cannot become knocked down.

Dauntless Resolve.text: Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit gains +3 ARM and Tough.

Frostbite.text: Frostbite causes cold damage. On a critical hit, the model hit becomes stationary for one round unless it has Resistance: Cold.

Airburst.text: Target any model in the spellcaster's control range, ignoring LOS. When resolving Airburst, ignore cover, concealment, and Stealth.

Crimson Ballet.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, models in its battlegroup gain Sprint. (At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, a model with Sprint can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.)

Hallowed Avenger.text: Target friendly Faction Cohort model gains Righteous Vengeance. (If one or more friendly Faction warrior models were destroyed or removed from play by enemy attacks while within 5" of a model with Righteous Vengeance during the last round, during your Maintenance Phase the model with Righteous Vengeance can make a Vengeance Move.)

Vanish.text: Place the spellcaster anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Vanish can be cast only once per activation.

Well of Hate.text: Models in the spellcaster's battlegroup gain Murderous while in its control range. Well of Hate lasts for one turn. (A model with Murderous gains an additional die on melee attack rolls against warrior models.)

Excessive Healing.text: The spellcaster gains Rapid Healing for one round. (When a model with Rapid Healing is damaged by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved remove d3 damage points from it.)

Prescience.text: Target friendly Faction model gains Future Sight. Prescience lasts for one turn.

Counterblast.text: When an enemy model advances and ends its movement or is placed within 5" of the spellcaster, the spellcaster can make one basic melee or ranged attack targeting that model, then Counterblast expires. Counterblast lasts for one round.

Ravening Hunger.text: The spellcaster gains Snacking. (When a model with snacking boxes a living model with a melee attack, it can choose to remove the boxed model from play. When it does, this model can remove d3 damage points.)

Arcane Dampening.text: The spellcaster gains Magic Static. Arcane Dampening lasts for one round. (Spells cast by enemy models within 10" of a model with Arcane Dampening model suffer +1 COST and −3 RNG.)

Force Wall.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Force Barrier for one round. (A model with Force Barrier gains +2 DEF against ranged attack rolls and gain Resistance: Blast.)

Draconic Aura.text: When an enemy model suffers a fire damage roll while within 10" of the spellcaster, add +2 to the roll. Fire continuous effects affecting enemy models within 10" of the spellcaster cannot expire. Draconic Aura lasts for one round.

Caustic Mist.text: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster's control range. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. A model entering or ending its activation in the template suffers the Corrosion continuous effect.

Vortex of Destruction.text: Damage rolls against enemy models in the spellcaster's melee range are automatically boosted.

Deadeye.text: Target friendly Faction model gains an additional die on its next ranged attack roll this turn.

Night's Reflection.text: Target model/unit suffers Blind for one round.

Slipstream.text: When the spellcaster ends its Normal Movement, choose one other large or smaller-based friendly Faction model within 2" of the spellcaster. You can place the chosen model completely within 2" of its current location, then Slipstream expires. A model can be placed as a result of Slipstream only once per turn. Slipstream lasts for one turn.

Admonition (spell).text: When an enemy model advances and ends its movement or is placed within 6" of target model in the spellcaster's battlegroup, the affected model can immediately advance up to 3", then Admonition expires.

Blackest Night.text: While within 10" of the spellcaster, enemy models suffer −1 to their attack rolls. Blackest Night lasts for one round.

Howling Flames.text: Howling Flames causes fire damage. Models hit by this attack suffer the Fire continuous effect.

Death March.text: Target friendly Faction unit gains +2 MAT and Vengeance. (During your Maintenance Phase, if one or more models in a unit with Vengeance were damaged by enemy attacks during the last round, each model in the unit can make a Vengeance Move.)

Warpath.text: When a friendly Faction model in the spellcaster's control range destroys one or more enemy models with a melee or ranged attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved one Cohort model in the spellcaster's battlegroup that is in its control range can advance up to 3". A Cohort model can advance as a result of Warpath only once per turn.

Distraction.text: Target warrior model/unit cannot make ranged attacks and suffers −2 DEF and MAT for one round.

Host of Shadows.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, models in its battlegroup gain Ghostly. Host of Shadows lasts for one turn. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

Aggravator.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, friendly Faction warbeasts gain Hyper-Aggressive. (When a model with Hyper-Aggressive suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance directly toward the attacking model.)

Sunder Spirit.text: An enemy warbeast damaged by Sunder Spirit loses its animus for one round.

Killing Ground.text: Friendly Faction models beginning a charge in the spellcaster's control range gain Pathfinder. Warbeasts in the spellcaster's battlegroup beginning their activations in its control range can charge or make slam power attacks against enemy models without being forced. Killing Ground lasts for one turn.

Obliteration.text: On a critical hit, models hit are knocked down.

Batten Down the Hatches.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, models in its battlegroup cannot become knocked down and gain +3 ARM but suffer −2 DEF. Batten Down the Hatches lasts for one round.

Quagmire.text: While B2B with target friendly Faction model/unit, enemy models suffer −2 DEF and cannot advance.

Battle Lust.text: Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit gains an additional die on melee damage rolls but suffers −2 DEF.

Bond of Gristle & Bone.text: Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit gains +2 ARM and Feign Death. (A model with Feign Death cannot be targeted by ranged or magic attacks while knocked down.)

Pigpen.text: While within 3" of the spellcaster, enemy models treat open terrain as rough terrain.

Deflection.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF against ranged and arcane attacks. Deflection lasts for one round.

Affliction.text: Target model/unit suffers −2 DEF. When a damage roll resulting from a direct hit fails to exceed the ARM of an affected model, the model suffers 1 damage point.

Thunder Strike.text: Instead of suffering a normal damage roll, a non-incorporeal model hit by Thunder Strike is slammed d6" directly away from the spell's point of origin and suffers a POW 14 damage roll. Collateral damage from this slam is POW 14.

Sure Foot.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 DEF and cannot become knocked down.

Dark Fire.text: When a living enemy model is destroyed by Dark Fire, the spellcaster gains the destroyed model's soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

Icy Grip.text: Target model hit without Resistance: Cold suffers −2 SPD for one round.

Eruption.text: This attack causes fire damage. On a hit, center a cloud effect on the model targeted. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. A model without Resistance: Fire entering or ending its activation in the AOE suffer the Fire continuous effect.

Perdition.text: When an enemy model is damaged by Perdition, immediately after the attack is resolved the spellcaster or one model in its battlegroup that is currently in its control range can advance up to 5" directly toward the nearest enemy model. A model can advance as a result of Perdition only once per turn.

Ravager.text: Target cohort model in the spellcaster's battlegroup gains Berserk. While affected by Ravager, a model cannot make Chain Attacks.

Watery Grave.text: When a model is boxed by Watery Grave, center a 3" template on the boxed model and then remove that model from play. The template is shallow water terrain that remains in play for one round. While in the template models gain Resistance: Fire.

High Noon.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 DEF and Dodge. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

Shellfish Bullets.text: The next enemy model to be hit by a ranged attack made by this model cannot secure Objectives, Scenario terrain, or Caches for one round.

Fortify.text: Target model in the spellcaster's battlegroup gains +2 ARM. That model and any friendly models B2B with it cannot become knocked down, be pushed, or be moved by a slam.

Fortune.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit can reroll its missed attack rolls. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Fortune.

Powder Keg.text: On a critical hit, the model directly hit loses its initial attacks and cannot make power attacks or special attacks for one round.

Brand of Fire.text: Brand of Fire causes fire damage. On a hit, the target model and the d3 nearest enemy models within 3" of it suffer the Fire continuous effect.

Fire Step.text: Enemy models currently within 2" of the spellcaster suffer a POW 13 fire damage roll. After the damage is resolved, place the spellcaster completely within 2" of its current location. Fire Step can be cast only once per activation.

Firestarter.text: Target a model in the spellcaster's battlegroup. That model's melee and ranged weapons gain Continuous Effect: Fire.

Rough Seas.text: When a friendly model in the spellcaster's control range is targeted with a ranged attack, the attacking model rolls an additional die on its attack roll. Discard the highest die of each roll. Rough Seas lasts for one round.

Morale Boost.text: When an enemy model is destroyed in the spellcaster's control range, the spellcaster can gain one fury point. The spellcaster's fury point total cannot exceed its ARC as a result of Morale Boost.

Descending Gloom.text: Target model hit suffers Blind. Centre a cloud effect template on the model hit. Enemy models entering or ending their activations in the template suffer Blind. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or magic attacks, suffers -4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)

Eye of Dhunia.text: While attacking target model/unit, friendly Faction models gain Eyeless Sight and their weapons gain Magical and Blessed.

Soothing Song.text: Remove up to 1 fury point from each friendly living Faction warbeast currently in the spellcaster's control range. Soothing Song can be cast only once per activation.

Lurker.text: The spellcaster gains Pathfinder and Bushwhack. Lurker lasts for one turn. (During its activation, a model with Bushwhack can make its Combat Action before its Normal Movement. If it does, it must make a full advance as its Normal Movement that activation.)

Chameleon.text: The spellcaster gains Pathfinder and Adaptive. (While a model with Adaptive is completely within a terrain feature that provides concealment or cover, it gains +1 DEF.)

Feint.text: The spellcaster gains Reposition [3"]. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]'s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

Slaughterhouse.text: The spellcaster's melee weapons gain Grievous Wounds. Slaughterhouse lasts for one turn. (On a direct hit, a model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)

Recoil.text: The spellcaster gains Swift Hunter. Recoil lasts for one turn. (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

Fog Wall.text: While within 3" of the spellcaster, friendly models gain concealment.

Torment.text: When a model is damaged by Torment, for one round it loses Tough, cannot remove damage, and cannot transfer damage

abilities.Alchemical Mask: This model does not suffer gas effects. When determining LOS or resolving attacks, this model ignores cloud effects and concealment granted from cloud effects.
abilities.Chemical Warfare: When an enemy model takes damage from a continuous effect while in this model's control area, double the damage.
abilities.Field Alchemy: This model can use one of the following special rules at any time during each of its activations.
abilities.Ephemeral Vitae: This model can cast one spell this activation without spending focus points.
abilities.Impenetrable Haze: Center a cloud effect template on this model. This AOE remains in play for one round. This model gains Stealth while completely within the template.
abilities.Super Fuel: Friendly Faction construct models currently within 5" of this model gain +2 SPD this turn.
abilities.Bond [Lukas]: If Apollo begins the game in Lukas' battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Apollo is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. If Apollo is bonded to Lukas and is in his control range at the start of Lukas' activation, Lukas can remove d3 damage points.
abilities.Arcane Realignment: While within this model's Leader's control Range, that Leader can reroll one failed arcane attack roll each turn.
abilities.Arcane Repeater: While this model's Leader is within 5" of it, that Leader's control range is extended 2".
abilities.Bulldoze: When this model is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when this model makes a trample power attack.
abilities.Reposition [3\"]: At the end of this model/unit's activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, this model can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.
abilities.Attack Type: Each time this weapon is used to make an attack, choose one of the following special rules.
abilities.Acid Wash: This attack causes corrosion damage. Models hit by this attack suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.
abilities.Blood of Urcaen: This attack causes magic damage. On a critical hit, upkeep spells and animi on the model/unit hit immediately expire.
abilities.Incendiary: This attack causes fire damage, and models hit suffer the Fire continuous effect.
abilities.Ice Cage: On a direct hit a model hit suffers a cumulative -2 DEF for one turn unless it has Resistance: Cold. When a model without Resistance: Cold is affected by two or more directly hitting Ice Cage attacks in the same turn, it becomes stationary for one round.
abilities.Ram: When an enemy model is hit by this weapon during this model's Combat Action, it becomes knocked down and can be pushed 1" directly away from this model. If the model hit is pushed, this model can immediately advance 1" directly toward it.
abilities.Attached: Before the start of the game, attach this model to a friendly Faction Leader for the rest of the game. Each Leader can have only one model/unit attached to it. The attached model is part of its Leader's battlegroup.
abilities.Magic Ability: Performing a Magic Ability special action counts as casting a spell.
abilities.Empower (★ Action): RNG 6. Target friendly Faction warjack. If the target warjack is in range and it was suffering Disruption, it is no longer disrupted. The warjack gains 1 focus point.
abilities.Guidance (★ Action): RNG 6. Target friendly model. If the model is in range, it gains Eyeless Sight and its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical for one turn.
abilities.Harmonious Exaltation (★Action): RNG 5. Target this model's Leader. If it is in range, once this turn when the Leader casts a spell, reduce the COST of the spell by 1.
abilities.Transmogrification Elixir: This model can use Transmogrification Elixir once per game during your Control Phase. Immediately mark all of this model's damage boxes and replace it with Big Alyce.
abilities.Traumatic Transformation: This model begins the game as Little Alyce. When all of this model's damage boxes are marked, instead of becoming disabled this model is replaced with Big Alyce. Damage points in excess of this model's remaining unmarked damage boxes are not applied to Big Alyce's damage boxes. If this model is replaced with Big Alyce during its activation, its activation ends. After this model is replaced with Big Alyce, apply effects that were on it to Big Alyce. When this model is replaced by Big Alyce, Big Alyce is not considered to have entered an area and does not trigger effects triggered by entering that area.
abilities.Hyper-Aggressive: When this model suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance directly toward the attacking model.
abilities.Hyper-Regeneration: Remove d3 damage points from this model at the start of each of its activations.
abilities.Jump: After it makes a full advance during its Normal Movement and before it performs its Combat Action, you can place this model anywhere completely within 5" of its current location.
abilities.All-Terrain (★Action): RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, it gains Pathfinder for one turn.
abilities.Repair [d3 +1] (★ Action): RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d3 +1 damage points from it.
abilities.Arcing Fire: When attacking with this weapon, this model can ignore intervening models.
abilities.Withering Humor: On a direct hit, living and undead models hit by this attack suffer -2 ARM and lose Tough for one turn unless they can ignore gas effects.
abilities.Journeyman Warcaster: This model is not a warcaster or Leader, but has the following warcaster special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Focus Manipulation, Power Field, and Spellcaster. This model must have at least one cohort in its battlegroup at the start of the game.
abilities.Soul Vessel: This model generates soul tokens as if it were a living model.
abilities.Dodge: This model can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.
abilities.Dogfighter: This model gains boosted attack and damage rolls against models with Flight.
abilities.Flying High: Ranged attacks targeting this model suffer -3 RNG. Friendly models can advance through this model if they have enough movement to move completely past its base. This model loses Flying High if it loses Flight.
abilities.Reposition [5\"]: At the end of this model/unit's activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, this model can advance up to 5", then its activation ends.
abilities.Swift Hunter: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".
abilities.Decrepitation: This weapon gains an additional die on damage rolls against construct and undead models.
abilities.Hallucination: On a direct hit, living models hit suffer Double Vision for one round. A model suffering Double Vision suffers -1 to attack rolls. Additionally, a model targeted by a model with Double Vision gains Dodge for that attack. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)
abilities.Putrefaction: On a direct hit, models hit gain Acid Blast for one round. (When this model is destroyed, models within 2" of it suffer a POW 12 corrosion blast damage roll and the corrosion continuous effect.)
abilities.Unnatural Affliction: On a direct hit, models hit lose Resistance: Cold, Resistance: Corrosion, Resistance: Electricity, and Resistance: Fire for one round.
abilities.Armor-Piercing (★ Attack): When calculating damage from this weapon, halve the base ARM stats of models hit.
abilities.Both Barrels (★Attack): This model gains +4 to the damage roll for this attack. This model cannot make additional ranged attacks with this weapon during an activation in which it makes a Both Barrels attack.
abilities.Iron Bane: Models hit without Resistance: Corrosion suffer Rust. (A construct suffering Rust suffers -2 ARM. Rust lasts for one round.)
abilities.Brutal Damage: On a direct hit, gain an additional die on this weapon's damage rolls against the target directly hit.
abilities.Sky-Dropped: Attacks with this weapon ignore cover. Models with Flight do not suffer blast damage from this attack.
abilities.Side Step: When this model hits an enemy model with an initial melee attack or a melee special attack, it can advance up to 2" after the attack is resolved.
abilities.Blind: A model is hit by this attack suffers Blind for one round. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or arcane attacks, suffers –4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)
abilities.Burster: When this attack boxes a living or undead model, the closest three enemy models within 3" of the boxed model suffer an unboostable POW 10 corrosion damage roll. This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack. After this damage is resolved, remove the boxed model from play.
abilities.Shadow Bind: A model hit by this weapon suffers Shadow Bind for one round. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers –3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)
abilities.Puncture: On a direct hit, all models hit suffer d3 damage points.
abilities.Acid Treatment (★Action): RNG 5. Target model's ranged and melee weapons gain Continuous Effect Corrosion for one round.
abilities.Heat Treatment (★Action): RNG 5. Target model's ranged and melee weapons gain Continuous Effect Fire for one round.
abilities.Magical Treatment (★Action): RNG 5. Target model's ranged and melee weapons gain Damage Type Magical for one round.
abilities.Prowl: While this model has concealment, it gains Stealth.
abilities.Smoke Bombs (★Action): Center a cloud effect template on this model. This template remains in play for one round.
abilities.Spontaneous Combustion: On a direct hit, add an additional die to this weapon's damage roll if the model hit is suffering a continuous effect. Add two dice instead if the model hit is suffering from two different continuous effects. Then, all continuous effects on that model expire.
abilities.Pyrocatalyst: This attack causes fire damage. On a critical hit, models hit suffer the Fire continuous effect.
abilities.Vitriolic Trajectile: This attack causes corrosion damage. On a critical hit, models hit suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.
abilities.Cumbersome: This model cannot attack with this weapon and with another weapon during the same activation.
abilities.Granted: Dodge: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Dodge. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)
abilities.Granted: Reposition [2\"]: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Reposition [2"]. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [2"]'s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 2", then its activation ends.)
abilities.Mission Objective: Once per game at any time during its unit's activation, this model can use Mission Objective. When it does, choose an enemy model/unit in this model's LOS. This activation, models in this unit gains +2 to attack and damage rolls against the chosen model/unit.
abilities.Aggressive: This model can run or charge without spending a focus point.
abilities.Anchor: Friendly warrior models cannot be knocked down while B2B with this model.
abilities.Set Defense: Models suffer –2 on charge and slam power attack rolls against this model.
abilities.Shield Guard: When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.
abilities.Ashen Veil: This model has concealment. Living enemy models without Resistance: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls while within 2" of this model.
abilities.Aetheric Blast: On a critical hit, the model hit becomes knocked down. Cloud effects touched by the spray expire.
abilities.Alchemical Accelerant: On a direct hit, a model hit by this attack suffers Oil for one round. (When a model affected by Oil suffers a fire damage roll, the roll is automatically boosted.)
abilities.Alchemical Vents: At the beginning of this model's activation, choose one of the following Alchemical Vents effects. While within 5" of this model, models are affected by the chosen effect. While its S system is crippled, this model loses the benefits of Alchemical Vents. Alchemical Vent effects last for one round.
abilities.Psychoactive Gas: A living warbeast directly hit by this attack gains 1 fury point unless they can ignore gas effects.
abilities.Psychomorphic Destabilizer: This attack causes magical damage. Models hit by this attack lose Incorporeal for one round.
abilities.Steam Pressure: If this model uses its Normal Movement to aim, this weapon gains +4 RNG that activation.
abilities.Chem Trail: On a direct hit, models hit by this weapon suffer the effects of the chosen Alchemical Vents effect. While its S system is disabled, this model loses the benefits of Chem Trail.
abilities.Reload [1]: This model can spend 1 focus or fury point to make one additional ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action.
abilities.Black Humor: This weapon gains Continuous Effect: Corrosion and Grievous Wounds for this attack. (On a direct hit, a model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)
abilities.Experimental Warhead: Models hit by this attack suffer the Fire and Corrosion continuous effects.
abilities.Girded: This model and friendly models B2B with it gain Resistance: Blast.
abilities.Force Aura (★Action): While within 3" of this model, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF and ARM against ranged attacks. Force Aura lasts for one round.
abilities.Psychic Assault (★Attack): Psychic Assault is a RNG SP 8, POW 12 arcane attack. This attack ignores LOS.
abilities.Psychokinetic Force (★Action): While within 5" of this model, enemy models suffer –2 MAT and RAT. Psychokinetic Force lasts for one round.
abilities.Steady: This model cannot become knocked down.
abilities.Critical Knockdown: On a critical hit, the model hit becomes knocked down.
abilities.Coagulum of Entropy: RNG 5. Target friendly faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Resistance: Corrosion. When an affected model is hit by a melee attack, the attacking model suffers the Corrosion continuous effect. Coagulum of Entropy lasts for one round.
abilities.Fortemorphic Elixir: RNG 5. Target friendly faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and gains Overtake. Fortemorphic Elixir lasts for one round. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)
abilities.The Good Stuff: RNG 5. Target friendly faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Tough and cannot be knocked down but suffers –1 to attack rolls. The Good Stuff lasts for one round.
abilities.Heal [d3 +2] (★Action): RNG 1. Target friendly living Faction model. If the model is in range, remove d3 +2 damage points from it.
abilities.Revivifier: This model can use Revivifier once per game at any time during its activation. While within 5" of this model, friendly Faction warrior models gain Tough. Additionally, when a friendly Faction warrior model makes a Tough roll of 4, 5, or 6 while within 5" of this model, that model can remove 1 damage point. Revivifier lasts for one round.
abilities.Anesthesia: A living model damaged by an attack with this weapon becomes stationary for one round.
abilities.Take Down: Models disabled by a melee attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by a melee attack made by this model are removed from play.
abilities.Brain Damage: A model damaged by an attack with this weapon cannot cast spells for one round.
abilities.Quake: On a direct hit, models hit become knocked down.
abilities.Rust: This attack causes no damage. Instead, on a direct hit constructs hit suffer –2 ARM for one turn.
abilities.Mental Force: This model can use Mental Force at the beginning of each attack. If it does, all attack and damage rolls resulting from the attack are boosted. After the attack is resolved, this model suffers d3 damage points.
abilities.Poltergeist: When an enemy model misses this model with an attack, immediately after the attack is resolved you can choose to push the enemy model d3" directly away from this model.
abilities.Smite (★ Attack): The model hit is slammed d6" directly away from this model. If the model hit has a larger base than the attacking model it is moved only half the distance rolled. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this weapon.
abilities.Carapace: This model gains +4 ARM against ranged attack damage rolls.
abilities.Brutal Charge: This model gains +2 to charge attack damage rolls with this weapon.
abilities.Flame Burst: When this model boxes an enemy model with this weapon, enemy models within 1" of the boxed model suffer the Fire continuous effect.
abilities.'Jack Hunter: This model gains an additional die on its melee and ranged damage rolls against warjacks.
abilities.Combat Alchemy: Once during this model's combat action, this model can spend an elixir token to cast a spell.
abilities.Combat Chemistry: At the start of each of this model's activations, it gains one elixir token. This model can have up to three elixir tokens at any time. During its Combat Action, this model can spend elixir tokens to gain additional melee attacks, boost an attack roll, or boost a damage roll. It can make one additional attack or boost one roll for each token spent.
abilities.Unstable Concoction: Unstable Concoction is a RNG 8, AOE 2, POW 12/8 arcane attack. Add 1 to the AOE value of this attack if the target is suffering from the Fire or Corrosion continuous effect. Add 2 to the AOE if the target is suffering from both.
abilities.Granted: Dual Shot: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Dual Shot. (If a model with Dual Shot uses its Normal Movement to aim, it can make one additional ranged attack this activation.)
abilities.Take Up: If this model is destroyed by an effect other than Take Up, you can choose a grunt in this unit within 1" of it to be destroyed instead. Remove that grunt from the table instead of this model. This model has the same number of unmarked damage boxes as the chosen grunt.
abilities.Detox (★Action): Remove any number of elixir tokens from this model.
