abilities.Health Care: This model does not suffer damage from elixir tokens while it has two or fewer elixir tokens and is within 5" of Little Alyce.
abilities.Juicer: During your Maintenance Phase, you can place one elixir token on di Morray. For each elixir token on di Morray, he gains +1 ARC and AAT. At the end of each of his activations, roll a d6. If the result is equal to or less than the number of elixir tokens on di Morray, he suffers 1 damage point for each elixir token on him. Di Morray cannot spend focus points to reduce this damage.
abilities.Rapid Healing: When this model is damaged by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved remove d3 damage points from it.
abilities.Exothermic Reaction: When this attack boxes a living or undead model, enemy models within 2" of the boxed model suffer an unboostable POW 12 fire damage roll and suffer the Fire continuous effect. This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack. Then the boxed model is removed from play.
abilities.Field Marshal [True Strike]: When a warjack in this model's battlegroup damages a warjack or warbeast with a melee attack, choose which column or branch suffers the damage.
abilities.Repair [d3+3] (★Action): RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d3 + 3 damage points from it.
abilities.Resourceful: This model can upkeep spells on models in its battlegroup without spending focus or fury points.
abilities.Flare: On a direct hit, models hit by this attack lose Stealth and suffer –2 DEF for one turn.
abilities.Fail-Safe: Target friendly Faction warjack gains +2 ARM and does not suffer the effects of crippled systems.
abilities.Jumpstart: Shakeable effects on models in the spellcaster's battlegroup that are currently in its control range expire. Models that suffered shakeable effects this turn are not affected by Jumpstart.
abilities.Mobility: Models in the spellcaster's battlegroup currently in its control range gain +2 SPD and Pathfinder for one turn.
abilities.Return Fire: When target friendly Faction model is targeted by an enemy ranged attack, after the attack is resolved the affected model can make one basic melee or ranged attack, then Return Fire expires. Return Fire lasts for one round.
abilities.Arcane Propulsion: Target cohort model in the spellcaster's battlegroup gains +2 SPD, +2 DEF, and Flight.
abilities.Firepower: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to its ranged attack damage rolls.
abilities.Occultation: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Stealth.
abilities.Tides of War: While in the spellcaster's control range, models in its battlegroup gain Reposition [3"]. Tides of War lasts for one turn.
abilities.Windstorm: The spellcaster gains Warping Winds. Windstorm lasts for one round. (When a friendly Faction model is targeted by a ranged attack while within 3" of this model, the attack suffers -3 RNG. Additionally, while within 3" of this model, friendly Faction models gain Resistance: Blast.)
abilities.Arms Caddy: Once per turn at any time during its activation and while within 5" of Mr. Clogg, Gearhart can use Arms Caddy. Replace his ranged weapon with one of the weapons on Mr. Clogg's card. Gearhart keeps that weapon until he uses Arms Caddy again.
abilities.Battle Plan: This model can use one of the following plans at any time during its activation.
abilities.Bloody Well Done!: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains an additional die on each model's first non-spray ranged attack roll this turn.
abilities.Give 'Em What For!: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model. If the model is in range, it gains Reciprocate for one round. (When it is missed by an enemy ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved a model with Reciprocate can make one basic ranged attack against the attacking model.)
abilities.Precision Strike: While within 10" of this model, friendly models ignore other friendly models when determining LOS. Friendly models can advance through other friendly models within 10" of this model if they have enough movement to move completely past them. Precision Strike lasts for one turn.
abilities.Mechanikal Seizure: A warjack hit by this weapon becomes stationary for one round.
abilities.Companion [Marshal General Baldwin Gearh: This model is included in any army that includes Marshal General Baldwin Gearhart. If Gearhart is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Gearhart's battlegroup.
abilities.Hit the Deck!: Ignore this model when determining which models would be hit by an AOE. If it would be hit by an AOE, it instead becomes knocked down. While this model is knocked down, ranged attacks targeting it automatically miss.
abilities.Johnny on the Spot (★Action): RNG 5. Target Gearhart. If Gearhart is in range, he immediately makes one basic melee or ranged attack.
abilities.Momentum: A small- or medium-based model directly hit by this attack is slammed d3" directly away from this model. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this weapon. In addition to suffering a normal damage roll, large-based models hit by this attack become knocked down.
abilities.Bombshell: On a critical hit, models hit are thrown d6" directly away from the attacker. Roll distance once for all models affected. Move models farthest from the attacker first. Instead of suffering blast damage, models hit but not directly hit suffer a POW 10 damage roll. The POW of collateral damage is 10.
abilities.Engine of Destruction: The spellcaster gains +2 SPD and +4 MAT and +4 to its melee damage rolls for one turn.
abilities.Jackhammer: Target model in the spellcaster's battlegroup currently in its control range immediately makes one basic melee attack.
abilities.Redline: Target warjack in the spellcaster's battlegroup gains +2 SPD and can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without spending focus. Additionally, the affected model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and collateral damage rolls. At the end of each of its activations, the affected warjack suffers d3 damage points.
abilities.Road to War: When a friendly Faction model in the spellcaster's control range destroys one or more enemy models with a melee or ranged attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved one Cohort model in the spellcaster's battlegroup that is in its control range can advance up to 3". A model can advance as a result of Road to War only once per turn.
abilities.Sentry: Target friendly Faction model gains Rapid Fire. (A model with Rapid Fire can make one basic ranged attack during your Maintenance Phase.)
abilities.Boundless Charge: During its activation, target friendly Faction model can charge without spending focus or being forced and gains +2 SPD and Pathfinder when it charges. Boundless Charge lasts for one turn.
abilities.Deceleration: While in the spellcaster's control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 ARM against ranged and arcane attack damage rolls. Deceleration lasts for one round.
abilities.Hot-Shot: Target model in the spellcaster's battlegroup gains boosted ranged attack damage rolls.
abilities.Snipe: Target friendly Faction model's/unit's ranged weapons gain +3 RNG.
abilities.Burning Ash: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster's control range. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. While in the template, living enemy models without Resistance: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls.
abilities.Disintegration: The model hit suffers –2 ARM for one round. A model boxed by Disintegration is removed from play.
abilities.Force Hammer: Instead of suffering a normal damage roll, a non-incorporeal model Force Hammer hits is slammed d6" directly away from the spell's point of origin and suffers a POW 12 damage roll. Collateral damage from this slam is POW 12.
abilities.Iron Flesh: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM and Resistance: Blast.
abilities.Telekinesis: Place target friendly model completely within 2" of its current location. A model can be placed by Telekinesis only once per turn.
abilities.Iron Bane (Alchemical Vents): Affected enemy construct models without Resistance: Corrosion suffer Rust. A construct suffering Rust suffers –2 ARM.
abilities.Miasma of Death: Affected living enemy models lose Tough and cannot have damage removed from them unless they can ignore gas effects.
abilities.Berserk: When this model destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.
abilities.Impervious Flesh: When this model suffers a damage roll, roll one fewer die.
abilities.Defense Formation: While in this model's control range and B2B with one or more models in its battlegroup with an extra-large base or smaller, models in this model's battlegroup gain +2 ARM and cannot become knocked down.
abilities.Field Marshal [Reposition 3\"]: Cohort models in this model's battlegroup gain Reposition [3"]. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)
abilities.Sleepwalker: This attack causes no damage. Instead, a living warrior model hit by this attack becomes stationary for one round. On a critical hit on a non-Leader living enemy warrior model, before it becomes stationary you take control of the model hit. You can immediately make a full advance with the enemy model followed by a basic attack, then the enemy model reverts to your opponent's control and becomes stationary.
abilities.Blood Boon: Once per activation, immediately after resolving an attack in which it destroyed an enemy model with this weapon, this model can cast a spell without spending focus or fury points.
abilities.Force Barrier: This model gains +2 DEF against ranged attack rolls and gains Resistance: Blast.
abilities.Long Shadows: When one or more living enemy models are destroyed by an arcane attack while in this model's control range, this model gains one focus or fury point.
abilities.Thunderbolt: Enemy models hit are pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model. On a critical hit, the enemy model becomes knocked down after being pushed.
abilities.Grievous Wounds: On a direct hit, a model hit by this weapon loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.
abilities.Sacrificial Pawn [Monstrosity]: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Monstrosity within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.
abilities.Bewitch: After this attack has been resolved, take control of target living enemy non-Leader warrior model hit by this attack. You can immediately make a full advance with the enemy model followed by a basic attack, then Bewitch expires. A model can be affected by Bewitch only once per turn.
abilities.Inflict Pain: When it hits a warbeast with this weapon, this model can place 1 fury point on or remove 1 fury point from the warbeast.
abilities.Drag: If this model hits an enemy model with an equal or smaller base with a basic attack with this weapon, immediately after the attack is resolved the hit model can be pushed directly toward this model until it contacts a model, an obstacle, or an obstruction.
abilities.Knockdown: When a model is hit by an attack with this weapon, it becomes knocked down.
abilities.Grand Slam: This model can make slam power attacks without spending a focus point. Models slammed by this model are moved an additional 2".
abilities.Mage Static: Spells cast by enemy models within 10" of this model suffer +1 COST and –3 RNG.
abilities.Telemetry: Other friendly Faction models gain +2 to arcane attack rolls against enemy models within 8" of this model.
abilities.Critical Paralysis: On a critical hit, a living model hit has its base DEF reduced to 5 and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks for one round.
abilities.Anatomical Precision: When this model's melee damage roll fails to exceed the ARM of the living model hit, that model suffers 1 damage point. A model disabled by a melee attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll.
abilities.Influence (★Attack): Influence is a RNG 10 arcane attack. Take control of target enemy non-Leader warrior model hit. The model immediately makes one basic attack, then Influence expires. A model can be affected by Influence only once per turn.
abilities.Instigate (★Action): While within 5" of this model, friendly large-based and smaller monstrosities gain +2 on attack and damage rolls. Instigate lasts for one turn.
abilities.Enliven (★Action): RNG 3. Target friendly Faction Cohort model. If the target is in range, the next time it suffers damage from an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved the target can make a full advance, then Enliven expires. Enliven lasts for one round.
abilities.Heal [d3+3] (★Action): RNG 1. Target friendly living Faction model. If the model is in range, remove d3+3 damage points from it.
abilities.Arcane Assist: If its Leader is within 5" of this model during your Control Phase, the Leader can upkeep one spell without spending a focus or fury point.
abilities.Spell Slave (★Action or ★Attack): This model must be in its Leader's control range to make the Spell Slave special action. When it does, it casts one of the spells on its Leader's card with a COST of 3 or less. This model cannot cast upkeep spells or spells with a RNG of SELF or CTRL. When casting an offensive spell, Spell Slave is an arcane attack.
abilities.Tune Up (★ Action): RNG 1. Target friendly Faction cohort. If the cohort is in range, it immediately stands up and is no longer stationary, continuous effects on the cohort expire, and the cohort gains Pathfinder for one turn.
abilities.Beat Back: Immediately after a basic attack with this weapon is resolved during this model's Combat Action, the enemy model hit can be pushed 1" directly away from the attacking model. After the enemy model is pushed, the attacking model can advance up to 1" directly toward it.
abilities.Thresher (★Attack): This model makes one melee attack with this weapon against each model in its LOS that is in this weapon's melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model. Thresher attacks are simultaneous.
abilities.Befuddle (★Attack): Befuddle is a RNG 10 arcane attack. On a hit, you can immediately take control and advance target enemy non-Leader model up to 3" then Befuddle expires. A model can move only once per turn as a result of Befuddle.
abilities.Heal [d3+1] (★ Action): RNG 1. Target friendly living Faction model. If the model is in range, remove d3+1 damage points from it.
abilities.Battle-Driven: When one or more models in this unit are damaged by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved models in this unit gains +2 ARM, +2 to their melee attack damage rolls, and Pathfinder for one round.
abilities.Critical Grievous Wounds: On a critical hit, a model hit by this weapon loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.
abilities.Granted: Inspiration: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain +1 to attack rolls.
abilities.Granted: Tough: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Tough.
abilities.Polarity Field: This model cannot be targeted by a charge or slam power attack made by a construct model.
abilities.Shield Wall: While this model is B2B with one or more models in its unit, it gains +2 ARM and cannot be knocked down.
abilities.Electro Leap: When a model is directly hit with a basic attack made with this weapon, you can have lightning arc to the nearest model within 3" of the model hit, ignoring the attacking model. The model the lightning arcs to suffers an unboostable POW 10 electrical damage roll. Lightning arc damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack.
abilities.Cerebral Channeling: While this model is in a friendly Faction Leader's control range, the Leader can channel spells through it. After a spell has been channeled through this model it becomes disabled.
abilities.Combo Strike (★ Attack): This model gains +4 to the damage roll for this attack.
abilities.Granted: Shield Guard: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Shield Guard. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)
abilities.Mind Burst: Once per turn at any time during this model's activation, you can choose one grunt in this unit. Enemy models within 2" of the chosen grunt suffer an unboostable POW 12 magic blast damage roll, then the chosen grunt is removed from play.
abilities.Granted: Blood-Bound: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Blood-Bound. (When a model with Blood-Bound destroys a living enemy model with an attack, after the attack is resolved you can return one destroyed model in its unit to play. Place the returned model completely within 3" of the attacking model. The returned model cannot activate the turn it returns to play. The destroyed enemy model is removed from play and does not provide a soul or corpse token.)
abilities.Granted: Gang: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Gang. (When making a melee attack targeting an enemy model in the melee range of another model in this unit, a model with Gang gains +2 to melee attack and melee damage rolls.)
abilities.Granted: Relentless Charge: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Relentless Charge. (While advancing as part of a charge, a model with Relentless Charge gains Pathfinder.)
abilities.Sigil of Power (★ Action): RNG 6. Target friendly model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. Sigil of Power lasts for one turn.
abilities.Vitalizer (★ Action): RNG 6. Target friendly monstrosity. If the target monstrosity is in range, it gains 1 focus point.
abilities.Volume Fire: Gain +1 to attack and damage rolls with this weapon against medium-based models and +2 to attack and damage rolls against larger-based models.
abilities.Lone Gunman: When attacking with this weapon, this model cannot participate in combined ranged attacks.
abilities.Combat Drugs (★ Action): RNG 5. Target Cohort in this model's battlegroup gains Aggressive for one turn. (A model with Aggressive can run or charge without spending a focus point or being forced.)
abilities.Journeyman Cephalyx Warcaster: This model is not a warcaster or Leader, but has the following warcaster special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Focus Manipulation, Healing, Power Field, and Spellcaster. This model may allocate focus point to monstrosities in it's battlegroup as if they were a warjack. This model must have at least one cohort in its battlegroup at the start of the game.
abilities.Limited Battlegroup [Aberration]: The only cohort that can be in this model's battlegroup is Aberration.
abilities.Sucker!: If this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, choose a friendly non-incorporeal warrior model within 3" of it to be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.
abilities.Flamethrower (AT): This weapon becomes Sp 8, POW 12, and gains Continuous Effect: Fire and Damage Type: Fire for this attack.
abilities.Void Blast: This weapon becomes AOE 2, POW 14/8 for this attack. Models destroyed by this attack are removed from play.
abilities.Full Auto (★Attack): Instead of making one attack with this weapon, this model can make d3 attacks. Do not choose an attack type when resolving these attacks.
abilities.Hormone Manipulation: When this model begins its activation in Nostilla's control range, choose one of the following Hormone Manipulation effects. Hormone Manipulation effects last for one round.
abilities.Adrenal Surge: This model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and Relentless Charge. (While advancing as part of a charge, models with Relentless Charge gain Pathfinder.)
abilities.Dopamine Boost: This model gains Overtake, and Swift Hunter. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".) (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)
abilities.Endorphin Dump: This model gains +2 to its attack rolls.
abilities.Critical Decapitation: On a critical hit, double the damage exceeding the ARM of the model hit. A model disabled by this attack cannot make a Tough roll.
abilities.Man Catcher: A warrior model hit by this attack suffers –2 DEF and cannot advance while within this model's melee range for one round.
abilities.Last Word: When this model is disabled by an enemy attack, it can immediately advance up to 3" and can make one basic melee attack.
abilities.Ascension Command: While within 10" of this model, friendly models with Flight gain Resistance: Blast and Flying High. Ascension Command lasts for one round. abilities.Phantom Protocol: While within 10" of this model, friendly models with Flight gain Dodge and Reposition [3"]. Phantom Protocol lasts for one round.
abilities.Repairable: This model can be targeted with Repair special actions as if it were a construct model.
abilities.Free Fall: When a model with Flight is hit by this attack it becomes knocked down and loses Flight for one round.
abilities.Unyielding: This model gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.
abilities.Field Marshal [Unyielding]: Cohort models in this model's battlegroup gain Unyielding. (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)
abilities.Double Strike: This model can spend focus or fury points to make two additional attacks with this weapon for each focus or fury point spent.
abilities.Configuration: At the start of each of this model's activations, it gains +2 MAT or RAT until the start of its next activation.
abilities.Polarize: If this attack directly hits an enemy model, before resolving damage immediately push models within 2" of the model hit 2" directly away or directly toward the model hit in the order you choose.
abilities.Field Marshal [Shield Guard]: Cohort models in this model's battlegroup gain Shield Guard.
abilities.Stall: A warjack hit by this weapon becomes stationary for one round.
abilities.Field Marshal [Reconstruct]: Cohort models in this model's battlegroup gain Reconstruct. (When a model with Reconstruct is disabled by an enemy attack, place it anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Then, remove 1 damage point from each system. A model can only use Reconstruct once per turn. Reconstruct only effects models with a large base or smaller.)
abilities.Magnetic Hold: Enemy model/unit directly hit suffers –2 SPD and DEF and cannot charge or make slam or trample power attacks. Friendly Faction construct models charging an affected model gain +2 SPD.
abilities.Activate Exponent Servitor: At the end of your Control Phase, you can put one Exponent Servitor into play completely within 2" of this model if there are fewer than two Exponent Servitors in play in Directrix's battlegroup.
abilities.Field Marshal [Arc Node]: Warjacks in this model's battlegroup gain Arc Node.
abilities.Inconsequential: This model can not score or contest Objectives, Scenario terrain, or Caches.
abilities.Imperil: For one round, when a model/unit hit by this attack suffers a damage roll, add +2 to the roll.
abilities.Accumulator [Warcaster]: When this model begins its activation within 3" of one or more friendly warcaster warrior models, this model gains 1 focus point.
abilities.Focus Battery: During your Maintenance Phase, do not remove unspent focus points from this model.
abilities.Power Transfer (★ Action): RNG 6. Target friendly Faction warjack. If the warjack is in range, this model can give that warjack any number of its focus points.
abilities.Induction Repeater: When another warjack in this model's battlegroup uses force induction, increase the range to 12".
abilities.Hand of Vengeance: When one or more friendly Faction warrior models are destroyed or removed from play by enemy attacks while within 5" of this model, this model gains +2 on melee attack and melee damage rolls for one round.
abilities.Ground Pounder (★ Attack): Place a 3" template anywhere completely within this weapon's RNG in this model's LOS. This model makes one ranged attack roll against each model in the template, ignoring concealment and Stealth. This model does not gain a bonus for aiming when resolving a Ground Pounder attack. Models do not gain the target in melee DEF bonus when resolving Ground Pounder attack rolls. Models hit suffer a ranged attack damage roll with a POW equal to the POW of this weapon. Ground Pounder attacks are simultaneous.
abilities.Blasted Earth: Models hit suffer –2 SPD for one round.
abilities.Targeting Flare: Instead of making an attack with this weapon during its Combat Action, you can place a 3" template anywhere completely within 10" of this model, with a center point in this model's LOS, ignoring intervening models. While a model is within the template, it loses Stealth and models can ignore cloud effects when determining LOS to it. The template remains in play for one turn.
abilities.Plasma Nimbus: If this model is hit by a melee attack, immediately after the attack is resolved you can choose to have the attacking model suffer a POW 10 electrical damage roll unless this model was destroyed or removed from play by the attack.
abilities.Direct Current: If this attack directly hits, you can choose to have all models whose bases are intersected by a line drawn between the center of the model directly hit and the center of this model suffer an unboostable POW 10 electrical damage roll. This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack.
abilities.True Sight: This model ignores cloud effects when determining LOS. This model also ignores Stealth.
abilities.Beacon: Friendly Faction models can charge or make a slam power attack against an enemy model hit by this weapon without being forced or spending focus. A friendly Faction model charging an enemy model hit by this weapon gains +2 SPD. Beacon lasts for one turn.
abilities.Ricochet: When this model directly hits an enemy model with an attack with this weapon, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can make another ranged attack with this weapon targeting another model within 4" of the model originally hit, ignoring LOS and this weapon's RNG. Attacks gained from Ricochet cannot generate additional attacks from Ricochet.
abilities.Sustained Attack: During this model's activation, when it makes an attack with this weapon against the last model hit by the weapon this activation, the attack automatically hits.
abilities.Flank [Angel]: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of a friendly Faction Angel model, this model gains +2 to the attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.
abilities.Launch Servitor: Once per turn at any time during this model's activation, you can place one Attunement Servitor solo into play completely within 2" of this model.
abilities.Skewer: When this weapon damages an enemy model with an equal or smaller base, immediately after the attack is resolved the damaged model can be pushed directly toward this model until it contacts a model, an obstacle, or an obstruction.
abilities.Power Grid: Once per turn at any time during this model's activation, you can place one Ionization Servitor into play completely within 2" of this model. There can be up to 3 Ionization servitors in play per Prime Conflux included in this army.
abilities.Created: This model does not begin the game in play.
abilities.Ionization [5\"]: When a model without Resistance: Electricity suffers an electrical damage roll while within 5" of this model, add +2 to the roll.
abilities.Servitor Satellites: At the start of this model's activation, remove any Permutation Servitors this model put into play from the table. Once per activation, after its Normal Movement, this model can place up to three Permutation Servitors anywhere within 1" of itself. During its Combat Action, this model can make one additional Aperture Pulse ranged attack for each Permutation Servitor it did not place that activation.
abilities.Firing Formulae: When this model makes a ranged attack with this weapon during its activation, determine the position of the Permutation Servitors this model put into play. For each B2B with it, this model gains an additional die on its attack rolls. For each within 1" of it, but not B2B with it, this model gains an additional die on its damage rolls.
abilities.Orbit: This model does not begin the game in play and does not activate. This model cannot be targeted or hit by attacks made by the model that put it into play. If the model that put it into play is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play.
abilities.Detonation: After this attack is resolved remove this model from play.
abilities.Reinforcements [small or medium-based co: During your Maintenance Phase, return d3 small or medium-based friendly destroyed construct Grunts to play. Models return with 1 unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts within 8" this model and within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.
abilities.Arcane Pattern Array: When another model within 10" of this model casts a spell, this model gains one power token. This model can have up to three power tokens at any time. During its Combat Action, this model can spend power tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.
abilities.Channeler: While this model is in a friendly Faction Leader's control range, the Leader can channel spells through it.
abilities.Dispel: When this weapon hits a model/unit, upkeep spells and animi on that model/unit immediately expire.
abilities.Apparition: During your Control Phase, place this model anywhere completely within 2" of its current location.
abilities.Blade Shield: This model gains +2 DEF against ranged attack rolls.
abilities.Leadership [Angels]: While within 10" of this model, friendly Angel models gain Apparition.
abilities.Defensive Strike: Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement or is placed in this model's melee range, this model can immediately make one basic melee attack against it.
abilities.Single Shot: After an attack with this weapon is resolved, this model cannot make another attack with it for one round.
abilities.Earth Shaker: When this model hits an enemy model with this attack, the model hit and models within 2" of it become knocked down.
abilities.Soul Taker: Soul Ripper: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed within 2" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model's soul token. After this model replenishes its essence during your next Control Phase, replace each soul token with 1 essence point.
abilities.Field Marshal [Sacred Ward]: Cohort models in this model's battlegroup gain Sacred Ward. (A model with Sacred Ward cannot be targeted by enemy spells.)
abilities.Revelations of the Outer Darkness: Once per turn, when a friendly Faction warrior within 12" of this model is destroyed or removed from play by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can cast a spell without spending essence, focus, or fury.
abilities.Hellhounds: When a Cohort model in this model's battlegroup destroys a living non-soulless enemy model with a melee or ranged attack, while the Cohort model is within 12" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model's soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.
abilities.Master Summoner: Horrors summoned by this model enter play with essence equal to their ESSENCE stat.
abilities.Alter the Deal: RNG 6. Target friendly non-soulless warrior model/unit gains Marked Soul for one turn. (Mark Soul - This model is a Marked Soul.)
abilities.Dark Legacy: When a friendly Faction model within 5" of this model is targeted by a ranged attack, the attack suffers -3 RNG.
abilities.Veneficium: When a spell or special rule on an enemy model causes one or more of this model's upkeep spells to expire, the enemy model suffers d3 damage points for each of this model's upkeep spells that expire. Roll a separate d3 for each spell.
abilities.Critical Shadow Bind: On a critical hit, the model hit suffers Shadow Bind for one round. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers -3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)
abilities.Critical Dispel: On a critical hit, upkeep spells and animi on the model/unit hit immediately expire.
abilities.Anathema: When this model is summoned, center a cloud effect template on it. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. A model without Resistance: Corrosion entering or ending its activation in the template suffers 1 point of corrosion damage.
abilities.Channeling: While this model is in its controller's control range, its controller can channel spells through it.
abilities.Psycho Static: Spells channeled through this model the turn it is summoned suffer -3 RNG.
abilities.Soul Parasites: Living non-soulless enemy models and enemy models with Soul Vessel suffer -2 to their attack rolls while within 4" of this model.
abilities.Wailing: While within 5" of this model, enemy models cannot cast spells or be used to channel spells.
abilities.Soul Claiming: When a living non-soulless enemy model is destroyed within 4" of this model while this model is in its controller's control range, its controller gains the destroyed model's soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.
abilities.Soul Void: Enemy models are not eligible to gain soul tokens from enemy models destroyed within 6" of this model.
abilities.Snacking: When this model boxes a living model with a melee attack, it can choose to remove the boxed model from play. When it does, this model can remove d3 damage points.
abilities.Hollow Ward: While within 4" of this model, friendly horrors gain +2 ARM against melee attack damage rolls made by construct, soulless, or undead models.
abilities.Soul Ravager: When this model destroys an enemy model with an attack, its controller gains the destroyed model's soul token regardless of the proximity of other models and the destroyed model is removed from play.
abilities.Soul Shatter: Once per turn, when a non-soulless living enemy model advances and ends its movement or is placed within 4" of this model, this model can spend 1 essence point. When it does the living model gains Soulless for the rest of the game and this model's Leader gains its soul token.
abilities.Arcane Pulse: When this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, enemy upkeep spells on models within 8" of it expire.
abilities.Dark Power: This model gains an additional die on arcane attack and arcane attack damage rolls. Discard the lowest die in each roll.
abilities.Gate Walker: Once per activation, immediately after this model casts a spell, you can place this model anywhere completely within 5" of its current location.
abilities.Marked Soul: This model is a Marked Soul.
abilities.Acrobatics: This model can advance through other models if it has enough movement to move completely past their bases. This model ignores intervening models when declaring its charge target.
abilities.Run & Gun: At the end of its activation, if this model destroyed one or more enemy models with ranged attacks that activation, it can make a full advance.
abilities.Entropic Force: While within 5" of this model, enemy models lose Tough and cannot have damage removed from them.
abilities.Ghostly: This model can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.
abilities.Shadow Guardian: You can choose not to deploy this model at the start of the game. If it is not deployed normally, you can put it into play when a friendly non-Umbral Faction model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack. Place this model completely within 3" of the hit model. This model is automatically hit by the ranged attack instead and suffers all damage and effects.
abilities.Gang: When making a melee attack targeting an enemy model in the melee range of another model in this unit, this model gains +2 to melee attack and melee damage rolls.
abilities.Battle Wizard: Once per turn, when this model destroys or removes from play one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved it can make one Magic Ability special attack or special action.
abilities.Bloodthirst: When it charges a living or undead model, this model gains +2" SPD.
abilities.Cleave: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can make one additional melee attack. This model can gain only one additional attack from Cleave each activation.
abilities.Vengeance: During your Maintenance Phase, if one or more models in this unit were damaged by enemy attacks during the last round, each model in the unit can make a Vengeance Move. Each model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3". After all models in the unit have moved, each model can then make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.
abilities.Forward Deployment: This model can be deployed up to 8" beyond your deployment zone.
abilities.Infernal Portal: When a model summons a horror while within 8" of this model, reduce the number of essence points the summoning model must spend by 1.
abilities.Soul Conduit: At the start of this models activation, if this model has no soul tokens on it, and there are no living non soulless enemy models within 15" of this model, this model gains a soul token.
abilities.Ancient Shroud: When a damage roll against this model exceeds its ARM, it suffers 1 damage point instead of the total rolled.
abilities.Dark Prophecy: When this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, enemy models within 8" lose their essence points and cannot cast spells, channel spells, or be forced for one round.
abilities.Willing Vessel: When an infernal master summons a horror and chooses this model to remove from play, the infernal master does not need to spend any essence points to summon the horror.
abilities.Insidious Plans: This model can use one of the following plans at any time during its activation:
abilities.Master Infernalist: This model is not an infernal master or Leader but has all the rules of an infernal master except it does not have a feat and cannot summon horrors. This model can have only light or lesser horrors in its battlegroup and must start with one in its battlegroup at the beginning of the game. This model replenishes its essence without sacrificing a model during its Control Phase.
abilities.Ill-Gotten Relics: This model can use one of the following relics at any time during its activation:
abilities.Granted: Self-Sacrifice: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Self-Sacrifice. (If a model with Self-Sacrifice is disabled by an enemy attack, you can choose a non-disabled model in its unit within 3" of the model with Self-Sacrifice to be destroyed and the model with Self-Sacrifice removes 1 damage point.)
abilities.Soul Taker: Vortex of Souls: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living model is destroyed while within 15" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model's soul token. This model can have up to five soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:
abilities.Soul Taker: Requiem: This model can gain soul tokens. When a friendly living model is destroyed while within 10" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model's soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:
abilities.Command Attachment [Cultist]: This command attachment can be added to a Cultist unit.
abilities.Arcana Infused: This model can have up to two Command Cards played on it each turn.
abilities.Outrage: When this model is damaged by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved this model gains +2 ARM, +2 to its melee attack damage rolls, and Pathfinder for one round.
abilities.Retaliatory Strike: If this model is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent's turn, after that attack is resolved this model can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. This model can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.
abilities.Field Marshal [Pain Response]: Warbeasts in this model's battlegroup gain Pain Response. (While damaged, a model with Pain Response can charge and make power attacks without being forced.)
abilities.Dream State: At the End of your Control Phase, this model can use Dream State. If it does, models in its battlegroup gain Incorporeal for one round. This model cannot use Dream State if it became Incorporeal during the last round.
abilities.Future Sight: This model can boost attack and damage rolls after rolling.
abilities.Hat Trick: When an enemy model is boxed while in this model's control range, you can replace the boxed model with a Phantasm model with the same or smaller base size. The replaced model is removed from play. You can only have one Phantasm model of each base size in play at any time.
abilities.Divinity: This model cannot be knocked down and never suffers Blind.
abilities.Godlike Power: Once per turn during its activation, this model can cast a non-animus spell that was cast by the enemy leader while in this model's control range during your opponent's last turn as if it were one of its own spells without spending fury. This model cannot upkeep spells that do not appear on its card.
abilities.Sacred Ward: This model cannot be targeted by enemy spells.
abilities.Dark Rituals: This model can channel spells through friendly Faction warrior models in its control range. Immediately after a spell is channeled through a model as a result of Dark Rituals, the model it was channeled through suffers d3 points of magical damage.
abilities.Kingdom of Silence: Once per turn, when a Cohort model in this model's battlegroup is damaged by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can cast a spell without spending fury.
abilities.Master of Ruin (★Action): Other models, friendly or enemy, suffer -2 ARM while within 5" of this model. Master of Ruin lasts for one round.
abilities.Crossroads: At the end of your turn, place three road markers anywhere completely within 6" of this model. At the start of your Maintenance Phase, you can place this model in the location of any of its road markers. The road markers are then removed whether or not this model was placed. If a model contacts a road marker, remove the road marker from the table.
abilities.Attuned Spirit: Once per activation, this model can cast the animus of a warbeast in its battlegroup without spending fury.
abilities.Hidden Paths: When an enemy model contacts a road marker while advancing, after that model completes its movement one friendly Faction model currently in this model's control range can advance up to 2". A model can move only once per turn as a result of Hidden Paths.
abilities.Arcane Machinery: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can use one of the following effects. Arcane Machinery effects last for one round.
abilities.Annoyance: Living enemy models within 1" of this model suffer -1 to attack rolls.
abilities.Mark Target: Other friendly Faction models gain +2 to ranged attack rolls against enemy models within 5" of this model and in its LOS.
abilities.Death Void: When this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, enemy animi and upkeep spells on models within 5" of it immediately expire.
abilities.Body Snatcher: Heart Eater: When this model destroys a living or undead enemy model with a melee attack, this model gains the destroyed model's corpse token. This model can have up to three corpse tokens at any time. This model can spend corpse tokens for the following:
abilities.Grave Secrets: If this model is in its Leader's control range during your Control Phase, its Leader can spend corpse tokens on this model to upkeep one spell for each token spent.
abilities.Rattle Bones: While this model has one or more corpse tokens and is in its Leader's control range, its Leader can channel spells through it.
abilities.Auto-Repair: During your Control Phase, remove d3 damage points from this model.
abilities.Time Stutter: Once per turn, when one or more of this model's aspects are crippled by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved place this model anywhere completely within 3" of its current location.
abilities.Vault: Once per activation, after making a full advance as its Normal Movement but before performing its Combat Action, this model can be forced to be placed completely within 5" of its current location.
abilities.Regeneration [d3]: This model can be forced to remove d3 damage points once per activation. This model cannot use Regeneration during an activation it runs.
abilities.Extended Control Range: When checking to see if this model is in its controller's control range, double the range.
abilities.Overtake: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".
abilities.Death-Powered: This model gains +1 ARM and +1 to its melee attack damage rolls for each corpse token currently on it.
abilities.Escapees: When this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, you can replace it with a Gremlin Swarm solo. Then this model is removed from play.
abilities.Otherworldly Entity: This model can be healed as if it were a living model.
abilities.Parlay (★Action): While within 5" of this model, enemy warrior models cannot target this model or its Leader with attacks. Parlay lasts for one round.
abilities.Swamp Gas (★Action): Center a cloud effect template on this model. The template is a gas effect and hazard that remains centered on the model for one round. While in the template, living enemy models suffer -2 to attack rolls.
abilities.Body Snatcher: Grave Robber [10\"]: When a living or undead model is destroyed while within 10" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model's corpse token. This model can have up to five corpse tokens at any time. This model can spend corpse tokens for the following:
abilities.Never Ending Pile: At the start of this model's activation, if it does not have any corpse tokens, it gains one corpse token.
abilities.Special Delivery: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can remove any number of corpse tokens and place them on a friendly model that can gain corpse tokens within 5" of it.
abilities.Warmth of the Grave: While this model has one or more corpse tokens, friendly Faction models gain +2 ARM while within 4" of this model +1" for each corpse token on this model.
abilities.Body Snatcher: Grave Robber [5\"]: When a living or undead model is destroyed while within 5" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model's corpse token. This model can have up to five corpse tokens at any time. This model can spend corpse tokens for the following:
abilities.Bone Working: When a model within 8" of this model makes an attack or damage roll, this model can spend a corpse token to cause that model to reroll the roll. Each roll can be rerolled only once due to Bone Working.
abilities.Grave Digger (★Action): RNG 3. Target friendly non-Leader Faction model. If the model is in range, it becomes dug in. (While dug in, a model gains cover and Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged.)
abilities.I Found One! (★Action): RNG 3. Target friendly Faction model with a Body Snatcher special rule. If the model is in range and does not have any corpse tokens, it gains one corpse token. A model can only be targeted by I Found One once per turn.
abilities.Undertaker: This model gains an additional die on attack and damage rolls against undead models.
abilities.Mischief: When an enemy warjack or battle engine begins its activation B2B with this model, roll a d3. On a roll of 1, the warjack or battle engine suffers -2 SPD that activation. On a 2, it suffers -2 to attack rolls that activation. On a 3, it suffers -2 to damage rolls that activation.
abilities.Serenity: At the beginning of your Control Phase, before leeching, you can remove 1 fury point from a friendly Faction warbeast within 1" of this model.
abilities.Leadership [Dread Rot]: While within 10" of this model, friendly Dread Rot models gain Ghostly.
abilities.Body Snatcher: Heart Eater (Isaiah): When this model destroys a living or undead enemy model with a melee attack, this model gains the destroyed model's corpse token. This model can have up to three corpse tokens at any time. This model can spend corpse tokens for the following:
abilities.Blood Rage: During its Combat Action, this model can spend corpse tokens to make additional melee attacks. It can make one additional attack for each token spent.
abilities.Meat for the Beast: During its Combat Action, this model can spend corpse tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.
abilities.Ancillary Attack (★ Action): RNG 3. Target friendly Faction warjack/warbeast. If the target is in range, it immediately makes one basic melee or ranged attack. A model can be targeted by an Ancillary Attack special action only once per turn.
abilities.Enrage (★Action): RNG 3. Target friendly warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, it gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls. Enrage lasts for one turn.
abilities.Shepherd's Call (★Action): Remove up to 1 fury point from each friendly living Faction warbeast currently within 3" of this model.
abilities.Sorrowful Rampage: If this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, during your next turn friendly Faction models gain +1 to attack and damage rolls.
abilities.Finisher: This model gains an additional die on damage rolls against damaged models.
abilities.Fortune Hunter: This model gains an additional die on its attack and damage rolls against character models.
abilities.Reciprocate: When it is missed by an enemy ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can make one basic ranged attack targeting the attacking model.
abilities.Snap Fire: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action, immediately after that attack is resolved this model can make one basic ranged attack with this weapon. Attacks gained from Snap Fire cannot generate additional attacks from Snap Fire.
abilities.Cradle Song (★Action): When a living enemy model ends its activation within 5" of this model, the enemy model becomes stationary for one round. Cradle Song lasts for one round.
abilities.Something Wicked (★ Action): While within 8" of this model, Monkeys gain an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls and Killing Spree. Something Wicked lasts for turn activation. (When a model with Killing Spree destroys one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, after that attack is resolved, it can advance up to 1" and make one additional melee attack.)
abilities.Reveille: Knocked down friendly Faction models within 10" of this model immediately stand up. Models that became knocked down this turn are not affected by Reveille.
abilities.Monkey Bite: While in melee with this model, living enemy models suffer -2 to melee attack rolls.
abilities.Relentless Charge: While advancing as part of a charge, this model gains Pathfinder.
abilities.The End of All Things: At the start of this model's activation, choose one of the following special rules:
abilities.Famine: This model's melee weapons gain Starve this activation. (A model damaged by a weapon with Starve must forfeit either its Normal Movement or its Combat Action during its next activation.)
abilities.Pestilence: Center a cloud effect template on this model. The template is a hazard and remains centered on this model for one round. Enemy models suffer -2 DEF while in the template.
abilities.Warp Strength: This model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls.
abilities.Hunter: This model ignores concealment and cover when making ranged attacks.
abilities.Immovable: This model has no Normal Movement, cannot become knocked down or be moved, and is automatically hit by melee attacks.
abilities.Strange Growth: Once per turn at any time during its activation, place this model anywhere completely within 5" of its current location.
abilities.Body Snatcher: Bag Man: A model disabled by a melee attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll. When this model destroys a living or undead enemy model with a melee attack, this model gains the destroyed model's corpse token and the destroyed model is removed from play. This model can have up to one corpse token at any time.
abilities.Victuals You Can Neither Raise Nor Buy: At any time during its activation while within 5" of this model, a friendly non-Dread Rot model with a Body Snatcher special rule can remove corpse tokens from this model and place them on itself.
abilities.Blood-Bound: When this model destroys a living enemy model with an attack, after the attack is resolved you can return one destroyed model in its unit to play. Place the returned model completely within 3" of this model. The returned model cannot activate the turn it returns to play. The destroyed enemy model is removed from play and does not provide a soul or corpse token.
abilities.Condition (★Action): RNG 6. Target friendly warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, you can place 1 fury point on it or remove 1 fury point from it.
abilities.Ghost Light (★ Attack): Ghost Light is a RNG 10 arcane attack. On a hit, you take control of target living enemy non-Leader warrior model. You can immediately advance the enemy model up to 3", then Ghost Light expires. A model can be affected by Ghost Light only once per turn.
abilities.Obscuring Mist (★ Action): Models in this unit gain concealment for one round.
abilities.Prey: After deployment but before the first player's turn, choose an enemy model/unit to be this model/unit's prey. This model gains +2 to attack and damage rolls against its prey. When the prey is destroyed or removed from play, choose another model/unit to be the prey.
abilities.Dark Seduction (★Attack): RNG 8. Target enemy non-Leader warrior model. If the attack hits you take control of the target model and can immediately make a full advance with that enemy model followed by a basic attack, then Dark Seduction expires. Dark Seduction can be cast only once per activation. A model can be affected by Dark Seduction only once per turn.
abilities.A Fate Worse Than Death (★Action): When a non-Leader model that is this model's Prey activates within 6" of this model, it becomes stationary for one round. A Fate Worse than Death lasts for one round.
abilities.Shadow Walk: Once per activation, when this model hits an enemy model with an arcane attack, after the attack is resolved, you may place this model completely within 5" of this current location.
abilities.Wages of Death: When this model makes an attack or damage roll, it can suffer 1 damage point to reroll the roll. Each attack or damage roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Wages of Death.
abilities.No escape: Enemy model/units that are this model's Prey roll one less die on attack rolls when attack this model.
abilities.Death Rattle (★Attack): Death Rattle is a RNG 10, POW 12 arcane attack. When Death Rattle boxes a living or undead non-Leader enemy warrior model, you can immediately take control of the model. The boxed model immediately makes one basic attack, then it is removed from play.
abilities.Grim Returns (★ Action): RNG 5. Target friendly trooper model. If the model is in range, return one destroyed Grunt to its unit. The Grunt returns with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunt within 2" of the target trooper model. The returned Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn it is returned to play.
abilities.Command Attachment [Hollowmen]: This command attachment can be added to a Hollowmen unit.
abilities.Granted: Snap Fire: While this model is in play the ranged weapons of models in its unit gain Snap Fire. (When a model destroys one or more enemy models with a weapon with Snap Fire during its Combat Action, immediately after that attack is resolved the model can make one basic ranged attack with the same weapon. Attacks gained from Snap Fire cannot generate additional attacks from Snap Fire.)
abilities.Sniper: Instead of making a damage roll to resolve a ranged attack, this model can inflict 1 damage point. A model disabled by a ranged attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll.
abilities.Command Attachment [Neigh Slayers]: This command attachment can be added to a Neigh Slayer unit.

properties.Clipped Wings: A model with Flight hit by this weapon suffers -2 SPD for one round.
properties.Lunge: This weapon becomes RNG 2 during this model's activation.
properties.Stormcall: Attacks made with this weapon ignore concealment, cover, elevation and stealth
properties.Arc Web: When this model's controller channels a spell through it, this model can channel the spell through another friendly Faction warjack with the Arc Node advantage within 10" of this model. The other model with the Arc Node advantage becomes the channeling model.
properties.Initiate Secondary Coiling Bypass: Once per turn at any time durong its activation, this model can spend one focus point to remove D3 damage from itself
properties.Side Step: When this model hits an enemy model with an initial melee attack or a melee special attack, it can advance up to 2" after the attack is resolved.
properties.Transfiguration: Models destroyed by this weapon are remov3ed from play. When an attack from this weapon destroyed one or more enemy models, return one destroyed grunt to a friendly faction unit within 8" of this model. The Grunt returns with one unmarked damage box. Place the grunt within 2" of another model in that unit. The returned Grunt must forfeit its normal movement and Combat action the turn it is put into play
